###### Our Services

### Helping businesses to navigate Data Privacy and Compliance with ease

[Learn more![](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/our-service-arrow.png)](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/services.php)

![Our Compliance Management Consulting Services icon: Gap Assessment Review ](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/dpdpa-act.png)

Gap Assessment Review

The Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA) requires
organizations to be well-prepared. Our Gap Assessment Review offers a detailed
evaluation and expert guidance to help your business meet compliance requirements
with minimal disruption. Led by experienced professionals, we provide tailored
recommendations to help you navigate DPDPA compliance and stay ready for evolving
regulations. [Learn More](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/readiness-review.php)

![](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/SVG-Icons/svg_315634.svg)

![Our Compliance Management Consulting Services icon: Consulting, Advisory and Audit ](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/compliance-assistance.png)

Consulting, Advisory and Audit

We provide complete support to help your business meet
DPDPA requirements. Our expertise includes building strong privacy frameworks and
creating customized policies to ensure legal compliance. Regular audits are key to
demonstrating compliance and maintaining trust, while proactive organizational and
IT controls protect your business from penalties. [Learn More](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/consulting-advisory-and-audit.php)

![](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/SVG-Icons/svg_315634.svg)

![Our Compliance Management Consulting Services icon: Data Protection Officer as a Service ](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/data-protection-officer.png)

Data Protection Officer as a Service

In today’s data-driven world, organizations face growing
pressure to protect personal data. The Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA)
requires appointing a Data Protection Officer (DPO), which goes beyond compliance—it
strengthens corporate governance. Our DPO as a Service turns this requirement into a
strategic advantage, enhancing your data protection framework and building
stakeholder trust. [Learn More](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/data-protection-officer-as-a-service.php)

![](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/SVG-Icons/svg_315634.svg)

![Our Compliance Management Consulting Services icon: Training Programs for DPDPA Compliance ](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/dpdpa-act-training.png)

Training Programs for DPDPA Compliance

Our training program is customized to your organization’s
needs, focusing on practical aspects of DPDP Act compliance. Key topics include
personal data policies, grounds of processing, data principal rights, risk
assessments, cross-border data transfer, third party compliance, security policies,
and Data breach notifications, Do's and dont's for employees, assessment and
Employee Compliance agreement. [Learn More](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/training-programs-for-DPDPA-compliance.php)

![](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/SVG-Icons/svg_315634.svg)

![Our Compliance Management Consulting Services icon: Contract Review & Data Processing Agreements ](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/contract-review-dpdp.png)

Contract Review & Data Processing Agreements

Our Contract Review and Data Processing Agreement
services ensure your organization complies with the Digital Personal Data Protection
Act (DPDP Act) when sharing personal data with third parties. We help draft and
review agreements that include all required provisions to protect personal data and
uphold the rights of Data Principals. [Learn More](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/contract-review-data-processing-agreements.php)

![](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/SVG-Icons/svg_315634.svg)

##### **DPCM**

DPCM is our solution to completely automate the management of
Data Principals' consents. It is capable of handling legacy data, paper consent
as well as live consents with equal ease.


[Learn more →](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/dpcm.php)

![Consent Management Framework Services icon2](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/224.png)

##### Consent Management Framework

Our data protection experts will develop specific consent templates and policies tailored to
the Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA) for your public-facing platforms.

###### Key Benefits:

- Respect for Privacy Rights
- Enable a business to manage users' consent requests
- Building Trust
- Handling data principal access requests

- Security in your compliance goals
- Uniform and standardized process

![DPDP Act compliance Risk and Mitigation Services icon2](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/363.png)

##### Risk and Mitigation

We assess risks related to DPDPA non-compliance and provide a comprehensive mitigation plan
to address these risks.

###### Key Benefits:

- Ensures compliance with DPDPA to avoid penalties and legal actions.
- Identifies and assesses potential risks associated with data processing.
- Provides a structured risk mitigation plan to prevent data breaches.
- Strengthens overall data security posture through proactive risk management.


![Icon](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/362.png)

##### Processing Activity Assessments

We conduct a thorough analysis of your business processes to identify gaps in your privacy
framework and ensure alignment with DPDPA requirements.

###### Key Benefits:

- Identifies potential data privacy gaps and risks in business operations.
- Ensures that all data handling processes are documented, highlighting organizational
accountability.
- Identify inefficiencies and redundancies in data handling and storage processes.
- Aligns processing activities with DPDPA requirements, reducing non-compliance risks.


![Policy & Privacy Notice Framework services icon2](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/364.png)

##### Policy & Notice Framework Notice

Our techno-legal consultants create organizational and public-facing notices that comply with
the Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA) framework.

###### Key Benefits:

- Ensuring Transparency and Control
- Protection Against Data Breaches
- Prompting Data Privacy Protection Activities
- Consent which serves as one of the primary legal bases for processing personal data.


![Icon](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/229.png)

##### DPIA Methodology

We implement a structured procedure and methodology to conduct Data Protection Impact
Assessments (DPIAs) for identified processing activities.

###### Key Benefits:

- Enhancing Compliance with Data Protection Laws
- Identifying and Mitigating Potential Data Risks
- Improving Data Management and Governance
- Building trust with stakeholders


![Principal Rights Management Procedure icon2](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/228.png)

##### Principal Rights Management Procedure

We will establish a process for efficiently managing and responding to principal rights
requests in a timely manner.

###### Key Benefits:

- Establishes a clear process for managing data principal requests efficiently.
- Ensures timely response to data principals, improving trust and transparency.
- Reduces regulatory risks by maintaining compliance with rights fulfilment timelines.

- Streamlines internal workflows for handling rights requests.

- Enhances user satisfaction by facilitating smooth access to personal data rights.

![DPDPA Employee Awareness Training Icon2](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/230.png)

##### Employee Awareness

We offer tailored training, assessments, certifications, and compliance agreements on DPDPA
for employees and key stakeholders.

###### Key Benefits:

- Educates employees on DPDPA requirements to minimize compliance risks.
- Reduces the likelihood of employee-related data breaches.
- Enhances data protection culture within the organization.
- Helps in implementing a sustainable privacy governance framework.


![Principal Rights Management Forms and Templates Services Icon](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/231.png)

##### Principal Rights Management Forms and Templates

We will create DPDPA-compliant rights request forms and templates to facilitate easy access
and exercise of rights by data principals.

###### Key Benefits:

- Simplifies the process for data principals to exercise their rights under DPDPA.
- Reduces administrative burden with pre-approved, compliant templates.
- Ensures consistency in responding to rights requests.
- Improves efficiency by standardizing documentation and workflows.

- Strengthens compliance readiness by ensuring correct regulatory procedures are followed.


![Employee Compliance Agreement Services Icon2](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/224.1.png)

##### Employee Compliance Agreement

We educate your workforce to minimize liability in the event of employee non-compliance with
data protection regulations.

###### Key Benefits:

- Provides clear guidelines on data privacy obligations, reducing ambiguity.
- Strengthens enforcement of data protection policies within the organization.
- Acts as a preventive measure against insider threats and negligence.
- Reduces liability by ensuring employees acknowledge their privacy responsibilities.


![Data Processing Agreement services icon2](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/232.png)

##### Data Processing Agreement

We help manage your compliance obligations with processors through vendor risk assessments
and customized Data Processing Agreements.

###### Key Benefits:

- Legal compliance
- DPA is tangible evidence of due diligence
- Defines each party's responsibilities and liabilities in relation to the processing.

- Ensures processors only act on the data fiduciary's instructions and for the specified
business purpose.

- Having DPDPA compliant DPAs in place helps build trust with natural persons, regulators,
and business partners.

![Third-Party Consent Sharing and Rights Fulfilment services icon](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/233.1.png)

##### Third-Party Consent Sharing and Rights Fulfilment

We facilitate the sharing of explicit consent and manage rights fulfilment across your
processors to ensure compliance.

###### Key Benefits:

- Ensures explicit consent is obtained and shared in compliance with DPDPA.
- Enhances transparency in third party data processing activities.
- Reduces legal risks by documenting consent-sharing mechanisms.

- Streamlines the process of fulfilling rights requests across vendors.

- Improves data governance and accountability in managing third party relationships.

![Consent management platform icon2](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/DPCM.1.png)

##### Data Principal Consent Management Tool

Our tool facilitates seamless collection, management, and tracking of data principal consents
while ensuring compliance with regulatory obligations.

###### Key Benefits:

- Real-time consent collection from websites, apps, and other platforms.
- Tracks consent lifecycle with detailed logs for compliance.
- Ensures previously collected data aligns with DPDPA rules.
- Customizable framework aligned with DPDPA requirements.

- Links consent with processing activities for better governance.
- Manages the full consent lifecycle, ensuring compliance.

![Data subject rights management tool icon](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/DPGR.1.png)

##### Data Principal Grievance Redressal Tool

Our tool streamlines the process of managing and resolving grievances raised by data
principals, ensuring compliance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA) and
enhancing transparency

###### Key Benefits:

- Enables data principals to easily lodge grievances through a user-friendly interface

- Provides a unified platform for tracking, monitoring, and managing grievances, offering
real-time visibility into the status and progress of each case
- Guarantees that grievances are resolved within the timelines specified by the DPDPA,
minimizing legal and regulatory risks
- Generates detailed reports and insights on grievance trends and resolution timelines,
helping organizations identify areas for improvement


![DPDPA compliance training platform icon2](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/DPAP.1.png)

##### Data Protection Awareness Program Tool

Our tool delivers customized training, assessments, and compliance modules to enhance data
protection awareness across your organization, ensuring alignment with the Digital Personal
Data Protection Act (DPDPA).

###### Key Benefits:

- Tailored content addressing DPDPA principles, privacy policies, and best practices.
Evaluates employee understanding and provides certifications to ensure compliance
readiness.
Delivers targeted training based on employee roles, minimizing specific compliance
risks.
Monitors training completion and generates audit-ready reports for regulators.
- Provides real-time dashboards to track training status and completion rates.
- Equips employees with knowledge to handle data breaches and mitigate risks effectively.


![Data protection impact assessment tool icon](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/DPIA.1.png)

##### Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA) Tool

Our tool streamlines the identification, assessment, and mitigation of data protection risks,
ensuring compliance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA).

###### Key Benefits:

- Analyzes data processing activities to identify potential privacy risks.
- Pre-approved templates aligned with DPDPA guidelines for consistent assessments.
- Evaluates data processing risks and recommends actionable mitigation measures.
- Generates detailed DPIA reports to demonstrate compliance and accountability.

- Facilitates seamless collaboration between teams for efficient DPIA completion.
- Tracks DPIA progress and ensures timely updates for ongoing compliance.

![DPDPA Third party risk assessment software icon2](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/DPTPA.1.png)

##### Data Protection Third party Assessment Tool

Our tool evaluates and monitors third party vendors to ensure their data processing
activities comply with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA).

###### Key Benefits:

- Identifies and assesses potential privacy risks posed by third party vendors.
- Pre-approved, DPDPA-compliant templates tailored for vendor evaluations.
- Continuously tracks vendor compliance to mitigate data protection risks.
Generates comprehensive reports to demonstrate due diligence and compliance.
- Facilitates creation, review, and monitoring of DPAs to ensure regulatory adherence.

- Identifies non-compliance and triggers corrective actions for risk mitigation.

###### How it works

## Ensure compliance and enhance user trust with our expert consulting and advisory solutions

1

##### Risk Assessment

We evaluate privacy practices across your organization,
documenting processes, data flows,
and requirements. Our assessment provides actionable strategies with clear stakeholder
responsibilities.

2

##### Policy Development

We develop comprehensive privacy policies and procedures tailored
to organization’s specific
needs and compliance requirements under the DPDP Act, ensuring all documentation meets
regulatory standards.

3

##### Compliance Tools Implementation

We address organizational obligations including data governance
and compliance verification
before deploying automation solutions for consent management, privacy notices, and incident
response.

4

##### Monitoring and Auditing

We establish monitoring protocols, track remediation progress, and
conduct comprehensive
compliance audits covering all essential privacy functions.

5

##### Reporting and Documentation

We maintain detailed documentation of all compliance activities,
providing regular reports on
compliance status, risk management progress, and emerging privacy concerns.

6

##### Ongoing Support and Updates

We provide continuous support to ensure your organization remains
compliant with evolving
regulatory requirements and privacy best practices.

## Frequently Asked Questions

## What services does DPDP Consultants offer for data privacy and compliance?

DPDP Consultants specializes in providing comprehensive services tailored to data
privacy and compliance needs. Our offerings include DPDP Act Readiness Review, Data
Privacy Policy Drafting, Privacy Impact Assessments, Contract Review for Data
Protection Compliance, DPDP Act Compliance Assistance, and Employee Training on Data
Protection Regulations. We aim to simplify the compliance journey for businesses by
offering end-to-end data protection solutions.


## How can DPDP Consultants assist businesses in achieving DPDP Act compliance?

DPDP Consultants offers expert assistance in aligning your business processes with
the requirements of the Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDP Act) 2023. Our
team conducts a thorough gap analysis, provides compliance roadmaps, and supports
the implementation of privacy frameworks. With our guidance, organizations can
confidently navigate complex regulatory requirements, reduce risks, and ensure
seamless compliance with the DPDP Act 2023.


## What is the DPDP Act 2023, and why is it essential for businesses?

The Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 is a transformative law in India
focused on protecting individuals' personal data. It mandates that businesses comply
with data privacy regulations, implement robust data management practices, and
ensure the security of customer information. Failure to comply can result in
significant penalties and reputational damage. Businesses must prioritize data
privacy and adopt compliance measures to stay competitive and trustworthy.


## Why is data protection crucial for modern businesses?

In today's digital age, data protection is a cornerstone of building customer trust
and ensuring business sustainability. It helps organizations safeguard sensitive
information, comply with laws like the DPDP Act 2023, and mitigate the risk of data
breaches. Effective data protection enhances brand reputation, fosters customer
loyalty, and ensures smooth operations in a data-driven economy.


## How can I contact DPDP Consultants for expert guidance on data privacy?

You can connect with DPDP Consultants through multiple channels. Visit our office in
Noida, Uttar Pradesh, call us at 0120-6930999, or email us at
info@dpdpconsultants.com. Our team of experts is ready to assist you with your data
privacy and compliance needs.

###### Who we are

#### Empowering Businesses to Seamlessly Navigate Data Protection Compliance

By prioritizing data protection and privacy, businesses can strengthen compliance
and build trust
with customers and stakeholders.


[Get Compliant Today](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/contact.php)

We understand that Data Protection and Data Privacy regulations can be complex and
time-consuming for
businesses. That’s why we empower our clients with the skills, tools, and knowledge needed to
navigate and ensure compliance with these critical regulations successfully. With our dedicated data
protection consultants, including certified Privacy Compliance Consultants and Data Protection
Officers, businesses can ensure comprehensive data risk mitigation. We navigate you to the evolving
landscape of data protection regulations to establish a solid foundation for privacy management
within your organization. We have expertise in assisting business in achieving data privacy
compliance, managing customer data securely, and enhancing your overall data governance framework.


Mission and vision

#### Transforming the Complex World of Data Protection into a Seamless Journey for Organizations Privacy and Compliance.

![DPDP Consultants mission icon ](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/missin-vision.png)

#### Mission

Our mission is to empower businesses to navigate the complexities of data protection and
privacy with confidence and ease. Through expert consulting and proprietary compliance
tools, we help organizations achieve and sustain regulatory compliance while fostering a
culture of security and accountability. We are committed to fostering a culture of
awareness and responsibility in data security, enabling our clients to safeguard
sensitive information, build consumer trust, and thrive in an ever-evolving regulatory
landscape.


![DPDP Consultants vision icon](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/vision.png)

#### Vision

Our vision is to be the premier consulting and solutioning partner in the realm of data
protection and data privacy, recognized globally for our innovative approach and
cutting-edge proprietary tools. We envision a future where all organizations prioritize
data privacy as a fundamental aspect of their operations, ensuring that personal
information is handled with utmost care and respect. By fostering an ecosystem of trust
and transparency, we aim to lead the way in shaping best practices and setting standards
for data protection compliance that empower businesses to succeed responsibly in the
digital age.

What we do

## Enabling Secure and Compliant Data Practices with Innovative Compliance Tools and Expertise

We provide a comprehensive suite of DPDPA compliance services,

tailored to
meet the unique
needs
of your business. Partnering with

organizations of all sizes and industries, we take a
personalized

approach to effectively address data protection and privacy compliance

challenges.


## Compliance Assessment

We conduct in-depth assessments of your data processing
practices to identify potential compliance gaps.



## Policy Development

Our team assists in the development of robust data
protection policies, ensuring they align with DPDP Act 2023 regulations.



## Training and Education

We offer specialized training programs designed to educate your
staff on the importance of data protection and privacy, equipping them with the
knowledge and skills needed for seamless DPDP Act, 2023 compliance.



## Data Audit

Our experts conduct data audits to help you identify and
manage personal data within your organisation effectively.



## Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIA)

We guide you in conducting DPIAs to assess and mitigate the
risks associated with your data processing activities.



## Incident Response Planning

We help you prepare for and respond to data breaches in
accordance with DPDP Act 2023 requirements.



###### Awards & Certifications

## Recognized for excellence,certified for your trust

Our team is proud to hold a range of industry-recognized awards and certifications that

demonstrate our commitment to excellence in

data privacy and compliance.

## DPDP Rules 2025
[Principal Rights](http://tech.portal-uat.dpdpconsultants.com/dpgr_form?_gl=1)![Logo](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/call-us.png) [18005711333](tel:+18005711333)

# Draft DPDP Rules 2025 - Ready Reckoner

| Rules & Schedule | Requirements | Recommended steps |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Rule 1: Basic Provisions** | Allows for adaptable implementation approach<br>- Final rules may have modifications, but no major changes anticipated. | - Effective Implementation of the Act has to be done in accordance with these rules |
| **Rule 2: Definitions** | - Rules are appendix to the Act henceforth definition given in the Act shall be<br> followed. | - Context-specific interpretations allowed |
| **Rule 3: Privacy Notice** | To establish fundamental requirements for privacy notifications:<br>- Must be independent and easily understandable to ensure transparency and<br> accountability<br> <br>- Requires itemized description and clear purpose<br>- Must cover both website and app platforms<br>- Withdrawal of consent mechanism to be updated in the Privacy Notice. | - Privacy Notice cannot be clubbed as part of terms and conditions.<br>- Itemized description of personal data with a clear purpose in a tabular form along<br> with<br> list of goods and services should be considered while formation of Privacy notice.<br> <br>- Update website and application with communication link for exercising data principal<br> rights along with withdrawal mechanism and grievance redressal. |
| **Rule 4 r/w Schedule 1: Consent Manager (CM)** | Mandatory requirement of Consent Manager<br>- Minimum financial requirement of 2 crores<br>- Must obtain independent registration.<br>- Must be interoperable between CM and Data Principal<br>- Required to maintain consent records for 7 years<br>- Must develop website/app for service access<br>- Regular audits as per Board requirements | - Establish framework for consent management<br>- Define interoperable requirements for CMs<br>- Consent managers to act as registered intermediaries to data fiduciaries.<br>- Consent manager will be dealing independently with consent and withdrawal of consent<br> for<br> an organisation.<br>- Consent manager to manage and document, the records of consent. |
| **Rule 5 r/w Schedule 2 & 7: Government Data Processing** | - Guidelines for data processing by government and its entities.<br>- Limited to legal purposes and public fund usage<br> <br>- Must maintain data accuracy<br>- Requires transparency in data usage<br>- Mandatory security measures | - Only government and its instrumentalities are exempted and dealing with government<br> does not perse exempt an organisation from its compliance obligations under the<br> DPDPA. |
| **Rule 6: Security Safeguards** | - Advanced encryption protocols required<br>- Access control systems shall be in place<br> <br>- Comprehensive monitoring capabilities<br>- Regular backup procedures<br>- Detailed logging requirements | - Organisations to update and review existing privacy and security frameworks.<br> <br>- Implementation of reasonable security measures for preventing data breach, the rules<br> specify a list of minimum safeguards requiring Fiduciaries to contractually obligate<br> processors to ensure Data Security |
| **Rule 7 Data Breach Management** | - Notify within 72-hour of the breach to the board and affected DPs<br>- Must provide: Breach description<br> <br>- Must provide potential consequence<br>- Remedial measures taken <br>- Safety measures should be implemented <br>- Business contact information to be provided | - Organisations to develop and enforce DPDPA compliant data breach procedures.<br>- Organisations to establish mechanism to notify Data Principals and Data Protection<br> Board<br> in case of a Data Breach within the stipulated timeline. |
| **Rule 8 r/w Schedule 3: Data Retention** | - 48-hour advance notice required before data deletion<br>- Schedule 3 guidelines to be followed<br>- Clear data retention purpose documentation required<br>- Statutory requirements must be met | - • Data Fiduciary to ensure establishment of Data Retention and Data Deletion for<br> active<br> and inactive users’ as per the procedure notified in the draft rules.<br>- Establish procedure to ensure that Data Principal is served with the Privacy Notice<br> at<br> least 48 hours prior to the Data Deletion. |
| **Rule 9: Contact Information** | - DPO contact details to be made available on website/app<br>- For response mechanism either DPO or any person who is able to answer on behalf of<br> Data Fiduciary should be appointed | - If applicable, Data Fiduciary to appoint Data Protection Officer (DPO)<br>- Data Fiduciary to publish the business contact information of the DPO on its website<br> or<br> application.<br>- Data Fiduciary to establish response mechanism and it shall also publish business<br> contact information of the DPO. |
| **Rule 10:Child/Disability Consent** | - Verifiable parental consent mechanisms<br>- Digital authentication systems<br>- Guardian verification protocols | - Data Fiduciary to ensure that age gating and age verification is completed.<br> <br>- Data Fiduciary to ensure due diligence is done by either using voluntary submission<br> of<br> data or government aggregators. |
| **Rule 11 r/w Schedule 4: Child Data Exemptions** | Exempted Sectors include:<br>- Educational institution <br>- Healthcare provider <br>- To follow Safety monitoring protocols | - Classes of Data Fiduciary specified under Schedule 4 do not enjoy blanket right to<br> process any kind of Personal Data rather they can process data only for specified<br> purpose as mentioned in the rules. |
| **Rule 12: Significant data fiduciary** | Obligations of Significant Data Fiduciaries:<br>- Annual impact assessment<br>- Algorithmic accountability<br>- Domestic data processing restrictions<br>- Regular audit requirements<br>- This requirement only applies to specific categories of Personal Data that will be<br> designated by the Central Government | - Data Fiduciary to ensure annual impact assessment and audit reports to be submitted<br> to<br> Data Protection Board<br>- Organisations to further ensure additional due diligence with regards to algorithmic<br> software.<br>- To safeguard data in transit and prevent tampering and eavesdropping, the<br> organization<br> will implement relevant mechanisms that adhere to industry standards. <br>This includes employing end-to-end encryption and utilizing network security<br>protocols<br>such as:<br> - Transport Layer Security (TLS)<br> - Secure File Transfer Protocol (SFTP)<br> - Secure Shell (SSH) File Transfer Protocol (SCP)<br> - Hypertext Transfer Protocol Secure (HTTPS) |
| **Rule 13: Data Principal Rights** | Data Retention for Children:<br>- Clear identification protocols<br>- Structured grievance resolution<br>- Nomination rights<br>- Standardized mechanisms for execution of rights<br>- Details of the means and purpose to be notified on the website or application. | - Data Fiduciary to update their Privacy Notice using simple language to explain what<br> data<br> you collect and purpose of such collection.<br>- Create a dedicated Data Principal rights section on the website or application<br> including step by step guide for making requests and providing multiple contact<br> options<br> (email, phone, form etc.)<br>- Maintain detailed records of all Data Principals’ request and to keep logs of all<br> actions taken on such requests. |
| **Rule 14: International Transfer** | Cross-border data handling:<br>- Compliance to be done in accordance with Central Government<br>- Foreign state sharing protocols to be followed | - Data Fiduciary to map all international data flows and identify which transfers<br> involve Indian customer data and document where the data is going and who receives<br> it.<br> <br>- Monitor Government notification and set up a process to verify compliance before<br> each<br> transfer.<br>- Regular review of international data sharing agreements<br>- Check for latest government order before initiating new international data transfers<br> as requirements may vary according to transferee country. |
| **Rule 15 r/w Schedule 2:Research Exemption** | - This section creates special rules for organizations that <br>process personal data for:<br>- Research purposes (like medical research or social studies)<br>- Archiving purposes(preserving information for historical value)<br>- Statistical analysis (analysing data patterns and trends) | - Create clear policies separating exempt vs non-exempt data processing |
| **Rule 16 to 22 r/w Schedule 5 & 6: Board Composition and Operations with Appeals** | Board Composition:<br>- Search committee protocols<br>- Appointment procedures<br>Board framework:<br>- Remote Operations<br>- Meeting procedures<br>- Decision-making protocols<br>- Staff appointment conditions<br>- Digital filing requirement Fee payment protocols Tribunal operations<br>Appeal Procedure<br>- Appeals to be directed to TDSAT. | - N.A. |
| **Rule 22 r/w Schedule 7: Information Requests** | Government authority:<br>- Information request by Central Government for sovereignty, integrity and National<br> security of the State | - Data Fiduciary to furnish such information with authorized signatory as may be<br> called<br> for.<br>- Data Fiduciaries to ensure not to disclose the information except with previous<br> permission in writing of authorized person of the State. |

## Fines Under DPDP Act
[Principal Rights](http://tech.portal-uat.dpdpconsultants.com/dpgr_form?_gl=1)![Logo](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/call-us.png) [18005711333](tel:+18005711333)

# Administrative Fines and Penalties Under the DPDP Act 2023

We believe that DPDP consulting is not just a legal requirement but a crucial element in
building trust and maintaining the integrity of your brand. Our team of seasoned
experts, with extensive experience in data privacy regulations, is dedicated to helping
businesses navigate the complexities of DPDP compliance effectively. We work closely
with organizations to ensure that they not only meet legal standards but also foster
customer confidence through robust data protection practices.


## Administrative Fines And Penalties

Fines, as defined in the DPDP Act, are as follows

| Sl. No. | Breach of provisions of the Digital Personal Data Protection Act or rules made<br> thereunder: | Penalty |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Breach in observing the obligation of Data Fiduciary to take reasonable security<br> safeguards to prevent a personal data breach under sub-section (5) of section 8. | May extend to two hundred and fifty crore rupees. |
| 2 | Breach in observing the obligation to give the Board or affected Data Principal<br> notice of a personal data breach under sub-section (6) of section 8. | May extend to two hundred crore rupees. |
| 3 | Breach in observance of additional obligations concerning relation to children<br> under section 9. | May extend to two hundred crore rupees. |
| 4 | Breach in observing any other obligation under the Act or rules. | May extend to one hundred and fifty crore rupees. |
| 5 | Breach in observance of the duties under section 15. | May extend to ten thousand rupees. |
| 6 | Breach of any term of voluntary undertaking accepted by the Board under section<br> 32. | Up to the extent applicable for the breach in respect of which the proceedings<br> under section 28 were instituted. |
| 7 | Breach of any other provision of this Act or the rules made thereunder. | May extend to fifty crore rupees. |

## Subcontractor Compliance Issues
[Principal Rights](http://tech.portal-uat.dpdpconsultants.com/dpgr_form?_gl=1)![Logo](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/call-us.png) [18005711333](tel:+18005711333)

# Managing Subcontractor and Third Party Issues in Data Protection

## Regulatory Obligation:

When a data fiduciary outsources personal data processing to a third party processor,
they are legally required to choose processors that provide sufficient guarantees of
implementing appropriate technical and organizational measures. These measures must be
in line with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDP Act) and ensure the
protection of data principals' rights.


In simpler terms, data fiduciaries must ensure their third party processors comply with
the DPDP Act. Failure to vet processors properly can result in significant penalties. To
foster trust and ensure compliance, processors may need independent certifications to
reassure clients of their commitment to data protection standards.


### Key Takeaways for Subcontractors and Processors under the DPDP Act:

Data Processing Agreement: Similar to the GDPR, the DPDP Act mandates that data
fiduciaries enter into clear and comprehensive agreements with data processors. These
agreements must outline:


1. Scope, purpose, and duration of data processing: Clearly defining what data will be
processed, for how long, and for what purpose.

2. Responsibilities of each party: Outlining the security measures each party is
responsible for, as well as the rights of the data principal (the individual whose data
is being processed).

3. Restrictions on how personal data can be handled: Ensuring that processors can only
handle personal data in accordance with the data fiduciary's instructions.


### Liability for Data Breach under the DPDP Act

The DPDP Act places liability on the data fiduciary for any non-compliance by the data
processor. If a data breach occurs as a result of the processor's actions, the data
fiduciary is responsible for ensuring they have:


1. Exercised due diligence in selecting the processor: The fiduciary must show that they
took all reasonable steps to ensure the processor had adequate data protection measures
in place.

2. Imposed proper contractual obligations: The fiduciary must have put in place a solid
contract that ensures the processor complies with the provisions of the DPDP Act.


In simpler terms, if a data breach occurs, the fiduciary must prove they acted responsibly in
choosing and managing their processors to prevent such breaches. Failing to do so can result
in penalties under the DPDP Act.


### Duty to Inform Breach under the DPDP Act

Data processors are obligated to immediately notify the data fiduciary upon discovering any
data breach. The data fiduciary is then responsible for informing the Data Protection Board
and the data principal as soon as possible, depending on the severity of the breach. This
timely communication is crucial for maintaining compliance with the DPDP Act.



### Compliance Audits for Data Processors

Under the DPDP Act, data fiduciaries must conduct regular compliance audits of their
processors to ensure adherence to the Act. Processors must fully cooperate with these
audits, providing necessary documentation and evidence to demonstrate compliance with data
protection regulations.


### Assisting Data Principals’ Rights under the DPDP Act

Processors are required to assist data fiduciaries in enabling data principals to exercise
their rights under the DPDP Act, such as the right to correction, erasure, or access to
personal data. This includes promptly addressing any requests made by the fiduciary on
behalf of the data principals.


### Penalties for Non-Compliance under the DPDP Act

The DPDP Act imposes significant penalties for non-compliance by data processors, especially
if they fail to follow the instructions of the data fiduciary or engage in unauthorized data
processing activities. Penalties can be severe, extending up to ₹250 Crores for severe
breaches, highlighting the importance of strict compliance with data protection regulations.

# Understanding DPDPA's Impact on Business Discontinuity

Navigating Compliance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA)

The
Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA) presents a significant challenge for
Indian companies, as failure to maintain compliance can lead to potential business
disruptions. One of the primary hurdles is the increasing difficulty of obtaining valid
consent from data principals. To stay compliant and ensure business continuity,
companies must adopt lawful approaches when engaging with data principals.


Key Issue: Determining the Right Approach and Timing for Data Processing

Under the DPDPA, companies must establish a legal basis for processing personal data. The law
mandates that businesses choose between obtaining consent or relying on legitimate use as
the foundation for their activities. This legal basis must be established before any
outreach—whether it’s a phone call, email, or other forms of contact with the data
principal.


### Understanding Consent Under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDP)

When it comes to consent under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDP), it’s critical
to obtain the data principal’s explicit, freely given, informed, and unambiguous agreement
for data processing. This consent must be clear, specific, and aligned with the intended
purpose of the data usage.


### Challenges in Implementing Consent and Ensuring Compliance

The real challenge lies in effectively implementing consent mechanisms. How will your
communication strategies adapt to ensure DPDP compliance? How can you engage with clients
and prospects within this new regulatory framework? What steps should you take if a data
principal exercises their right to erasure under the DPDP Act?


### Navigating the DPDP Act: Expert Guidance for Compliance

Navigating the intricacies and nuances of the DPDP Act can be complex. Our expert team is
here to help you achieve compliance, avoid penalties, and build lasting trust with your
customers by ensuring your business operations remain in line with the latest data
protection regulations.

## Data Protection Violations Case Study
[Principal Rights](http://tech.portal-uat.dpdpconsultants.com/dpgr_form?_gl=1)![Logo](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/call-us.png) [18005711333](tel:+18005711333)

# Case Study: Understanding Data Protection Violations and Their Consequences

Learn how Digivo Media Ltd, incurred a £50,000 fine for dispatching
over 415,000 text
messages between March 24, 2021, and September 7, 2021.

## ICO Fines Digivo Media Limited £50,000

About Digivo Media Limited

Digivo Media Limited, operating in the highly sensitive and
data-intensive
domain of finance, insurance, and credit, brings to light the complex interplay between
business operations and data protection. In this sector, where consumer data is not just an
asset but the backbone of every transaction, safeguarding personal information is crucial.


The company’s core activities, which hinge on the processing and analysis
of
vast amounts of personal data, place it under the intense scrutiny of data protection
regulations. This sector, characterized by its reliance on consumer trust and regulatory
compliance, faces unique challenges in data management.

This is a case study of why Digivio Media Limited was fined by the ICO.


### Detailed Account of the Violation

Digivo Media Ltd., a debt management company that operated under the
name Rid My Debt,
was fined £50,000 for sending and receiving more than 415,000 sent text messages between
March 24, 2021, and September 7, 2021. This was an act that starkly contravened data
protection norms.

The texts urged recipients to visit the Rid My Debt website to
receive a “free pack” or
“free advice.” It is illegal for these emails to have been sent without authorization.


These texts, sent without the recipient’s explicit consent, were not
mere nuisances but a
profound intrusion into personal privacy, [breaching Regulation 22\\
of the Privacy and Electronic Communications (EC Directive) Regulations 2003\\
(“PECR”).](https://ico.org.uk/media/action-weve-taken/mpns/4027237/digivo-media-ltd-mpn-20231003.pdf) Regulation 22 of PECR states:

Source : [Information Commissioner’s Office](https://ico.org.uk/media/action-weve-taken/mpns/4027237/digivo-media-ltd-mpn-20231003.pdf)

By bypassing this essential protocol, Digivo Media Limited not only
violated regulatory
standards but also undermined the trust and preferences of the very individuals it
sought to engage, turning a potential connection into a case of compliance failure.

### Analysis of the Legal Framework and Penalty

The Privacy and Electronic Communications Regulations (PECR) operate
alongside the
General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), forming a comprehensive framework for data
privacy. PECR specifically governs electronic communications, placing a stringent
emphasis on the sanctity of consent, especially in marketing practices.

This regulation complements the broader principles of GDPR, which
mandates the protection
and lawful processing of personal data across various contexts. Digivo Media Limited’s
breach of PECR, by sending unsolicited texts, not only violated specific provisions
related to electronic communications but also reflected a broader disregard for the
foundational privacy principles outlined in GDPR.

Enforcement of these regulations falls under the jurisdiction of the
Information
Commissioner’s Office (ICO), a body empowered to uphold information rights and data
privacy. The ICO’s imposition of penalties on Digivo Media Limited accentuates its
decisive role in maintaining compliance. This enforcement action serves as a testament
to the ICO’s commitment to protect individuals’ data rights and its readiness to employ
punitive measures against entities that disregard legal obligations.

Source : [Information Commissioner’s Office](https://ico.org.uk/media/action-weve-taken/mpns/4027237/digivo-media-ltd-mpn-20231003.pdf)

Article 4(11) of the UK GDPR sets out the essential ingredients of
valid consent.
‘Consent’ is valid which is-


- freely given

- specific
- informed and unambiguous indication of the data subject’s wishes expressly given

- and signifies or communicates agreement to the processing of personal data relating
to him or her.


None of these parameters were met by Digivo Media Ltd which led to
the contravention of
PECR and GDPR laws. Amid the increasing need to be on top of the game, the
interpretation of laws must be accurate and it must strictly conform to the usage of
language in the provisions of the acts.


For the industry at large, the fine serves as a stark reminder of the
consequences of
non-compliance. It serves as a warning and a deterrence, indicating the ICO’s
attentiveness and willingness to enforce rules. This punitive step probably has a
cascading effect, making other businesses examine and improve their data protection
protocols.


### Broader Industry Implications

As industries handle sensitive personal and financial information,
the imperative to
safeguard data is paramount. The increasing sophistication of cyber threats and the
global nature of business have further magnified the need for strong data protection
measures to be in place.


Recent trends in enforcement reveal a clear trajectory: regulatory
bodies worldwide are
intensifying their scrutiny and are more willing to impose substantial fines for
non-compliance. This shift reflects a broader recognition of data privacy as a
fundamental right.


The enforcement actions, such as the fine against Digivo Media
Limited, serve as clear
indicators of this trend and act as catalysts, compelling industries to elevate their
data protection standards. Companies are now investing more in secure data
infrastructure, comprehensive privacy policies, and employee training, recognizing that
in the digital age, the protection of customer data is not just a legal obligation but a
core aspect of business ethics and sustainability.


### Common Privacy Compliance Mistakes and How to Avoid Them

Common privacy compliance mistakes include:


- Inadequate understanding of regulations

- Poor data management practices

- Insufficient employee training


Companies often underestimate the scope of data protection laws of
their country like the
GDPR, and PECR of Europe or even the DPDP Act of India, leading to non-compliance in
areas like obtaining consent or data processing. Poor data management practices, such as
inadequate data security measures or failure to maintain accurate records of consent,
further compound these issues.


To avoid these pitfalls, companies should


- Invest in comprehensive training programs, ensuring that all employees understand
the importance of data protection and their role in maintaining compliance

- Regularly updating privacy policies and consent forms in line with evolving
regulations is crucial

- Implementing robust data security measures, conducting frequent audits, and
maintaining clear, accessible records of data processing activities are also vital

- Engaging with data protection experts or legal counsel can provide valuable insights
and guidance, helping companies navigate the complex landscape of data protection
compliance effectively.


### Lessons and Future Prospects For India

India can learn several important lessons from the fines imposed
under the Privacy and
Electronic Communications Regulations (PECR) and the General Data Protection Regulation
(GDPR), particularly in the context of companies like Digivo Media Ltd. Companies in
India will have to adapt to a new way of working in compliance with the Digital Personal
Data Protection Act (DPDPA) which should come into operation once the 25 rules
accompanying the act are out. One thing is amply clear and it is that despite taking
huge steps towards compliance, even a small oversight can land a company in huge losses
and a reputation change. Therefore, 100% compliance is essential at all times.


From the Digivo Media case, it is evident that the fines imposed by
the empowered bodies
in protection of data are huge. The fine incurred in this case was £50,000, which
amounts to INR 52,41,966 in India. Moreover, the more the inconsistencies in compliance
arise, the more the fines. As the saying goes, “Precaution is better than cure” and so
companies in India will have to adhere to strict DPDPA regulations to steer away from
non-compliance.


### In Conclusion

Source : [DPDP Consultants](https://dpdpconsultants.com/)

The Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA) will likely bring
various compliance
obligations for businesses. They’ll need to create data protection policies, appoint a
Data Protection Officer (DPO), perform impact assessments, and follow specific data
protection principles closely. Therefore, the DPDPA law will require you to be on your
toes all the time, you couldn’t afford to be 80% or even 99% compliant but fully 100%
compliant.

DPDPA Consultants tailor solutions to fit your organization’s
requirements. DPDP tools
help organizations simplify, automate, and handle important parts of the Indian Digital
Personal Data Protection Act.

- **The Data Principal Consent Management (DPCM)** is a SAAS tool that helps
businesses get valid consent and is designed to automate the management of personal
data consent requests, establishing a robust system for tracking and handling such
requests within companies.

- **The Data Principal Grievance Redressal (DPGR)** tool’s goal is to cut down the
time it takes to handle complaints and ensure keep track of unresolved requests,
alerting the relevant people if there are any hold-ups or delays.

- **Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA)** tool is a structured process created
to assist in methodically interpreting, recognizing, and substantially minimizing
risks related to data protection.

- **Data Protection Awareness Program (DPAP)** carries out subscription-based
awareness programs, businesses can hold required awareness sessions on a regular
basis and then follow up with assessments.


Companies looking to get DPDP Act compliant will soon need access to
automated tools is
because it’s impossible to manage all of this with traditional processes and methods.

Data Principal's consent.
It is capable of handling legacy data, paper consent as well as live consent with equal
ease.

Your browser does not support the video tag.


##### [Data Principal Grievance Redressal](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/dpgr.php)

DPGR process is an essential part of any comprehensive data
protection strategy. Our tool
ensures that Data Principal's rights are duly honored and providing a clear mechanism
for
addressing complaints and concerns related to their personal data as per the DPDP Act.


Your browser does not support the video tag.


##### [Data Protection Awareness Program](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/dpap.php)

DPAP tool educates employees, stakeholders, and partners
about the importance of
safeguarding personal and sensitive data, adhering to privacy laws, and implementing
best practices in their daily operations. The tool fosters a culture of privacy and
accountability within the organization.

Your browser does not support the video tag.


##### [Data Protection Impact Assessment](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/dpia.php)

DPIA tool helps build compliance with the DPDP Act 2023
whereby companies need to hold
periodic DPIAs. DPIA tool infuses automation to the entire DPIA process. It allows
stakeholders/DPOs to conduct DPIAs through a user-friendly platform and track risks
identified during the DPIA ensuring that every stakeholder is aware of the developments
on the mitigation of these identified risks.

Your browser does not support the video tag.


##### [Data Protection Third Party Assessment](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/dptpa.php)

DPTPA tool is ensuring that the data fiduciary is regularly
reviewing the compliance of
the third parties or sub processors and assessing the risk associated with the Third
parties, which can in turn help them in decision making while selecting a third party or
Mandating work to them. Additionally, if there is any personal data shared with the
Third parties, they are also notified about the rights of the data principal.

![Cookie consent management tool icon](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/cookie/dpdp-cookie.png)

##### [Cookie Consent Management Tool](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/dptpa.php)

CCM is our comprehensive solution for capturing, managing,
and documenting user consent for website cookies. Fully compliant with GDPR, ePrivacy
Directive, CCPA/CPRA, and India’s DPDP Act, the tool enables businesses to display
dynamic consent banners, categorize cookies, and allow users to adjust preferences at
any time. With automated cookie blocking and real-time consent logs, CCM ensures both
transparency for users and accountability for organizations, helping build trust and
demonstrate regulatory compliance effortlessly.

Key Features and Benefits

##### Integrated Data Discovery with Consent Manager and Principal Rights enhances data governance, compliance, and security

![Key benefits of compliance management tools icon: Automated Data Classification & Consent Mapping ](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/automated-data.png)

##### Automated Data Classification & Consent Mapping

- The Data Discovery Tool scans databases (MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL), file storage
(Google Drive, OneDrive).
- It classifies the data based on predefined categories (e.g., PII, financial data,
health records).
- The Consent Manager maps the discovered data to consent records, ensuring
compliance.

![Key benefits of compliance management tools icon: Real-time Consent Validation for Data Access ](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/real-time.png)

##### Real-time Consent Validation for Data Access

- When an application tries to access personal data, the Consent Manager checks for
valid consent.
- If consent is missing, access can be restricted or logged for review.

![Key benefits of compliance management tools icon: Data Principal Access Rights (DPAR) Automation ](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/data-subject-requests.png)

##### Data Principal Access Rights (DPAR) Automation

- The Consent Manager handles user requests (Right to Access, Right to Erasure, etc.).

- The Data Discovery Tool locates personal data across different storage locations.

- Automated workflows can retrieve, anonymize, or delete the relevant data as per the
request.

![Key benefits of compliance management tools icon: Risk Assessment & Compliance Monitoring ](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/risk-assessment.png)

##### Risk Assessment & Compliance Monitoring

- The Data Discovery Tool scans for unprotected sensitive data and alerts the Consent
Manager.
- The Consent Manager ensures compliance with regulations (e.g., GDPR, DPDP Act).

![Key benefits of compliance management tools icon: Data Retention & Auto-Deletion ](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/data-retention.png)

##### Data Retention & Auto-Deletion

Based on expiry of consent, the Consent Manager can trigger a request to the Data
Discovery Tool to:

- Delete personal data from all identified locations.
- Anonymize or archive data that must be retained for compliance reasons.

![Key benefits of compliance management tools icon: API-based Communication & Webhooks ](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/api-based.png)

##### API-based Communication & Webhooks

- The Data Discovery Tool can push data discovery reports to the Consent Manager via
an API.
- The Consent Manager can send real-time webhooks to the Data Discovery Tool to
initiate scans

when consent policies change.

###### Data Principal Consent Management Tool

Our Consent Manager ensures that consent is specific, freely given,
informed, and affirmatively indicated through clear action, as mandated by the Digital Personal Data
Protection Act, 2023. Data Principals retain complete control through easily accessible consent
withdrawal mechanisms and comprehensive notice provisions easily accessible consent withdrawal
mechanisms and comprehensive notice provisions. With robust automation and multi-channel
integration, our DPCM optimizes consent lifecycle management across all digital touchpoints,
maintaining detailed consent records, enhancing regulatory compliance, mitigating enforcement risks,
and streamlining operational efficiency while upholding Data Principal rights.

The Tool

##### Seamless Consent Management, Trusted Compliance for a Privacy-First Future

A tool that simplifies consent management while ensuring compliance and
user privacy

## Data Principal Grievance Tool
[Principal Rights](http://tech.portal-uat.dpdpconsultants.com/dpgr_form?_gl=1)![Logo](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/call-us.png) [18005711333](tel:+18005711333)

# Comprehensive Grievance Redressal for Compliance, Accountability, and User Confidence

Our solution streamlines grievance redressal while upholding

compliance,
transparency, and user
satisfaction.


[Book a Demo](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/contact.php) [Schedule a call](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/contact.php?act=schedule)

Your browser does not support the video tag.


###### Data Principal Rights and Grievance Management Tool

Our Grievance Redressal Management (DPGR) Tool simplifies grievance
handling by providing a user-friendly, automated platform that ensures compliance with the Digital
Personal Data Protection Act, 2023(DPDP Act). It empowers Data Fiduciaries to efficiently manage,
track, and resolve grievances while maintaining audit-ready records and adhering to statutory
timelines. With intuitive workflows and a centralized dashboard, our tool enhances transparency,
reduces response times, and builds trust with Data Principals.

The Tool

##### Efficient Grievance Redressal, Strengthening Compliance and Trust

An efficient solution for grievance redressal, ensuring compliance and
building user
confidence

[Schedule a demo](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/contact.php?act=schedule)

![Compliance Management Software image of Data Principal Grievance Redressal Tool dashboard ](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/dpgr-tool.svg)

Key Features

##### Achieve compliance and foster transparency with our innovative grievance management solution

![Key Features of Data Principal Grievance Redressal tool: Effortless Grievance Management for Data Fiduciaries ](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/tools-icon/159.png)

##### Effortless Grievance Management for Data Fiduciaries

A highly flexible and integrable platform, seamlessly embedding into
any online portal or website of the Data Fiduciary to ensure efficient and compliant
grievance management. All grievances are documented and routed to the designated
Compliance Officer for expeditious resolution within reasonable timelines as mandated by
the DPDP Act.


![Key Features of Data Principal Grievance Redressal tool: Seamless Grievance Redressal Mechanism](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/tools-icon/160.png)

##### Seamless Grievance Redressal Mechanism

A user-friendly platform enabling Data Principals to raise grievances
on data processing issues like erasure, denial of access, or rights violations.
Complaints are captured and routed to the appropriate processing manager or DPO for
swift, compliant resolution.

![Key Features of Data Principal Grievance Redressal tool: Timely Response with Clear communication](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/tools-icon/161.png)

##### Timely Response with Clear communication

Our system ensures adherence to statutory timelines through
configurable SLAs and automated escalation protocols. Each submission generates response
and acknowledgments with unique reference identifiers, ensuring transparency throughout
the redressal process.

![Key Features of Data Principal Grievance Redressal tool: Advanced Rights and Grievance Tracking & Management](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/tools-icon/162.png)

##### Advanced Rights and Grievance Tracking & Management

The Compliance Officer or DPO monitors all rights requisitions in
real-time with detailed regulatory compliance metrics. The platform maintains
comprehensive evidentiary records while providing Data Principals with transparent
visibility into their grievance status through automated notifications.

![Key Features of Data Principal Grievance Redressal tool: Seamless Integration with Your Digital Ecosystem](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/tools-icon/163.png)

##### Seamless Integration with Your Digital Ecosystem

The Rights and Grievance Management solution integrates smoothly with
third party platforms (e.g., CRM, data platforms), automatically notifying them to cease
processing or delete records when revocation of consent or erasure requests are
validated, ensuring consistent rights enforcement and demonstrable compliance across all
data environments.

# Data Protection Awareness Program for Driving Compliance, Fostering Awareness, and Protecting Sensitive Information

Our solution promotes data protection awareness among employees while ensuring
compliance, mitigating
risks, and safeguarding sensitive information.


[Book a Demo](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/contact.php) [Schedule a call](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/contact.php?act=schedule)

Your browser does not support the video tag.


###### Data Protection Awareness Program Tool

Our Data Protection Awareness Program is a comprehensive Learning Management System
(LMS) designed to provide online training on data privacy in line with the Digital Personal Data
Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act). The training modules are tailored to educate both employees and
privacy champions within the organization, ensuring they stay informed and equipped to uphold data
protection standards effectively.

The Tool

##### Empowering Data Protection Awareness:Strengthening Compliance and Organizational Trust

A streamlined solution for data protection training, ensuring compliance
and empowering
employees

[Schedule a demo](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/contact.php?act=schedule)

![Compliance Management Software image of Data Protection Awareness Program Tool dashboard ](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/dpcm-tool.svg)

Key Features

##### Boost Compliance and Enhance Data Security with Our Cutting-Edge Employee Awareness Program

![Key Features of Data Protection Awareness Program tool: Comprehensive Course Modules](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/DPAP-Icons/191.png)

##### Comprehensive Course Modules

The Learning Management System(LMS) offers preconfigured beginner and
intermediate courses covering data protection laws, DPDP Act compliance, data security,
and privacy by design.

![Key Features of Data Protection Awareness Program tool: Self-Paced Learning](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/DPAP-Icons/192.png)

##### Self-Paced Learning

Users can complete courses at their own pace with progress tracked
automatically across devices, ensuring seamless learning and timely completion.

![Key Features of Data Protection Awareness Program tool: End-of-Module Assessments](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/DPAP-Icons/193.png)

##### End-of-Module Assessments

Assess learner comprehension with module-end evaluations, including
multiple-choice questions, true/false prompts, and interactive scenarios, ensuring a
solid grasp of data protection concepts.

![Key Features of Data Protection Awareness Program tool: Scoring and Pass/Fail Criteria](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/DPAP-Icons/194.png)

##### Scoring and Pass/Fail Criteria

Set clear pass/fail criteria with a minimum score of 80% and full
course completion, ensuring competency in critical data protection areas and reinforcing
accountability.

![Key Features of Data Protection Awareness Program tool: Compliance Tracking and Reporting](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/DPAP-Icons/195.png)

##### Compliance Tracking and Reporting

The platform tracks learner progress and assessment completion,
ensuring employees meet data protection standards. Training compliance dashboards
provide departments with real-time visibility into their team's compliance status.

![Key Features of Data Protection Awareness Program tool: Employee Certificate Generation](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/DPAP-Icons/196.png)

##### Employee Certificate Generation

Require learners to accept terms, privacy policies, and acknowledge
their data handling responsibilities before receiving an auto-generated completion
certificate. The certificate includes key details such as the learner's name, course
title, and completion date.

![Why Choose Our Data Protection Awareness Program tool icon: Adherening Data Protection Laws](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/DPAP-Icons/197.png)

##### Adherening Data Protection Laws

Ensure adherence to the DPDP Act, 2023

and other global data
protection laws

![Why Choose Our Data Protection Awareness Program tool icon: Risk Reduction](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/DPAP-Icons/198.png)

##### Risk Reduction

Minimize data breaches by training

employees on secure data

# Impact Assessment Tool for Risk Management, Compliance, and Informed Decisions

Our solution simplifies impact assessment while ensuring compliance, risk mitigation,
and informed
decision-making.


[Book a Demo](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/contact.php) [Schedule a call](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/contact.php?act=schedule)

Your browser does not support the video tag.


###### Data Protection Impact Assessment Tool

Our advanced, highly customizable DPIA platform simplifies and automates the entire
Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA) process across various processing activities and functions.
It enables organizations handling sensitive, large, and high-risk data to proactively identify,
evaluate, and mitigate potential data privacy risks while implementing robust safeguards to protect
personal information. The platform ensures smooth regulatory compliance while enhancing operational
efficiency, transparency, and accountability in managing data privacy risks.

The Tool

##### Streamlined Impact Assessment, Ensuring Compliance and Risk Control

A comprehensive solution for impact assessment, ensuring compliance and
fostering
accountability

[Schedule a demo](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/contact.php?act=schedule)

![Compliance Management Software image of Data Protection Impact Assessment Tool dashboard](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/dpia-tool.svg)

Key Features

##### Drive compliance and operational efficiency with our streamlined impact assessment solution

![Key Features of Data Protection Impact Assessment Tool: Streamlined Workflow and Efficiency](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/tools-icon/169.png)

##### Streamlined Workflow and Efficiency

Leverage pre-built templates and pre-seeded questionnaires aligned
with global privacy laws to ensure consistency and save time. Configure DPIA frequency
and utilize automated action trackers to effectively mitigate risks.

![Key Features of Data Protection Impact Assessment Tool: Risk Assessment & Mitigation](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/tools-icon/170.png)

##### Risk Assessment & Mitigation

Automatically calculate risk levels, gain real-time insights, and
receive appropriate mitigation suggestions. Update risk levels in subsequent DPIAs based
on implemented measures.

![Key Features of Data Protection Impact Assessment Tool: Risks tracking and management](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/tools-icon/171.png)

##### Risks tracking and management

Generate an Action Tracker to address identified risks with predefined
actions and controls tailored to risk severity. Monitor mitigation completion to ensure
all necessary steps are taken to reduce privacy risks.

![Key Features of Data Protection Impact Assessment Tool: Comprehensive Reporting & Audit Trail](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/tools-icon/172.png)

##### Comprehensive Reporting & Audit Trail

Create detailed compliance reports, maintain an exhaustive audit trail
with timestamped changes, and access interactive dashboards for real-time insights into
risk levels and compliance status.

![Key Features of Data Protection Impact Assessment Tool: Collaboration and Version Control](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/tools-icon/173.png)

##### Collaboration and Version Control

Enable seamless collaboration among stakeholders, allowing
simultaneous completion of DPIA sections to enhance accuracy, teamwork, and efficiency.


![Key Features of Data Protection Impact Assessment Tool: Audit and Documentation](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/tools-icon/174.png)

##### Audit and Documentation

Maintain a real-time audit trail for transparency and accountability.
Securely store supporting documents and manage action trackers with target and actual
completion dates.

# Third Party Evaluation for Risk Mitigation, Compliance, and Trust Building

Our system simplifies Third Party assessments while ensuring compliance, reducing
risks, and improving oversight.


[Book a Demo](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/contact.php) [Schedule a call](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/contact.php?act=schedule)

Your browser does not support the video tag.


###### Data Protection Third Party Assessment and Compliance Tool

Our Data Protection and Third Party Assessment (DPTPA) Solution empowers
organizations to seamlessly
manage vendor compliance by issuing clear instructions, monitoring vendor actions, and receiving
real-time confirmation of adherence to data protection requirements. In the event of non-compliance,
the system promptly alerts the Data Fiduciary, identifying potential risks and enabling them to take
proactive corrective measures to safeguard sensitive data and maintain regulatory compliance.

The Tool

##### Proactive Third Party Assessment, Ensuring Compliance and Risk Mitigation

An advanced solution for Third Party assessment, promoting compliance and
safeguarding
operations

[Schedule a demo](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/contact.php?act=schedule)

![Compliance Management Software image of Data Protection Third Party Assessment Tool dashboard ](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/DPTPA.png)

Key Features

##### Ensure compliance and foster trust with our advanced Third Party assessment solution

![Key Features of Data Protection Third Party Assessment Tool: Third Party Due Diligence](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/tools-icon/179.png)

##### Third Party Due Diligence

Effortlessly capture and document the security controls and mechanisms
in place of the Third Party. With real-time tracking and automated reminders, the data
fiduciaries are enabled to assess the risk associated with the third parties.

![Key Features of Data Protection Third Party Assessment Tool: Configurable Assessments](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/tools-icon/180.png)

##### Configurable Assessments

Data fiduciaries can configure assessment questionnaires based on
applicable laws and compliance requirements. The solution is fully customizable,
user-friendly, and supports version control for seamless updates.

![Key Features of Data Protection Third Party Assessment Tool: Third Party Risk Evaluation](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/tools-icon/181.png)

##### Third Party Risk Evaluation

The platform calculates a risk score based on vendor responses and
DPO/compliance team reviews, using configurable criteria aligned with organizational
requirements for a flexible and customized assessment.

![Key Features of Data Protection Third Party Assessment Tool: Integrated Data Management Across Third parties](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/tools-icon/182.png)

##### Integrated Data Management Across Third parties

Our Integrated Solution provides a robust and comprehensive framework
for managing data principal rights, automatically notifying third parties and ensuring
that appropriate actions are taken, with evidence retained.

![Key Features of Data Protection Third Party Assessment Tool: Third Party Consent Verification](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/tools-icon/183.png)

##### Third Party Consent Verification

DPTPA ensures that third parties verify consent before initiating
outreach, maintaining compliance and safeguarding Personally Identifiable Information
(PII) throughout the process.

# Driving Consent Transparency, Mitigating Risk, and Safeguarding Digital Trust

The solution puts users in control of their data, delivering privacy, compliance, and
transparency in one seamless experience.


[Book a Demo](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/contact.php) [Schedule a call](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/contact.php?act=schedule)

![Cookie consent management tool icon](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/cookie/dpdp-cookie.png)

###### Cookie Consent Management (CCM) Tool

Our Cookie Consent Manager (CCM) Tool provides an intuitive, automated
solution for capturing and managing user consent for website cookies. Fully
compliant with global privacy laws including the GDPR, ePrivacy Directive, CCPA/CPRA, and India’s
DPDP Act. The platform ensures that users are
informed, in control, and empowered to manage their cookie preferences. From initial consent banners
to ongoing preference management and cookie
blocking, our tool delivers complete transparency and regulatory assurance.

The Tool

##### Seamless Cookie Consent Management, Trusted Compliance for a Privacy-First Future

Designed to respect user choice, our Cookie Consent Manager ensures
transparent consent management and effortless compliance.

[Schedule a demo](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/contact.php?act=schedule)

![Compliance Management Software image of Data Principal Consent Management Tool dashboard ](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/cookie/cookie.png)

Key Features

##### Our Cookie Consent Manager enhances user trust by providing clear consent controls and maintaining compliance with data protection laws.

![Key Features of Data Principal consent management tool: Live Consent Acquisition Across Channels ](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/cookie/292.png)

##### Automated Cookie Categorization

Our platform systematically scans and classifies all website cookies
and group them into
predefined categories such as Necessary, Functional, Analytics, Marketing and Custom
Categories.

![Key Features of Data Principal consent management tool: Advanced Consent Tracking & Management ](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/cookie/293.png)

##### Cookie Scanner & Auto Classification

The built-in scanner detects both first-party and third-party cookies
on all web pages,
identifying tracking technologies through automated analysis. A rule-based engine maps
cookies to correct categories, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

![Key Features of Data Principal consent management tool: Seamless Compliance for Historical Data ](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/cookie/294.png)

##### Customisable Consent Banner & Pop-up

Display clear and customizable cookie consent banners or pop-ups upon
user visits. Inform
users of cookie usage and enable acceptance, rejection, or customization of preferences
in
line with compliance requirements under DPDP Act, and other privacy laws.

![Key Features of Data Principal consent management tool: Customizable to Fit Business Requirements ](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/cookie/295.png)

##### Consent Preference Center

Offer users the ability to review, modify, or withdraw consent at any
time through a persistent
Preference Center. This ensures continued transparency and honors user autonomy
throughout the data lifecycle.

![Key Features of Data Principal consent management tool: Integrated Data Management Across Departments ](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/cookie/296.png)

##### Cookie Blocking Before Consent

Ensure that non-essential cookies and tracking scripts are
automatically blocked from
executing until valid user consent is received. This critical feature guarantees lawful
data
collection by design, adhering to global regulatory mandates.

![Key Features of Data Principal consent management tool: End-to-End Solution for Data Fiduciaries ](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/cookie/297.png)

##### Integrated with Consent Management Ecosystem

The CCM Tool integrates seamlessly with the broader Data Principal
Consent Management
(DPCM) platform, synchronizing cookie preferences with consent for all data processing
activities. This unification ensures consistent rights enforcement across all digital
touchpoints.

![Key Features of Data Principal consent management tool: End-to-End Solution for Data Fiduciaries ](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/cookie/298.png)

##### Consent Logging & Audit Trail

Maintain a tamper-proof log of all consent actions including
first-time acceptance, preference
changes, and withdrawals. These verifiable, time-stamped records serve as demonstrable
evidence of compliance during audits.

![Why Choose Our Data Principal Consent Management Tool icon: Ensure Compliance to DPDP Act ](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/cookie/299.png)

to ensure legal and transparent

and privacy laws.

consent.

classification.
