###### Industries we serve

## **From custom compliance frameworks** **to industry-specific** **guidance**

Unified Data Protection Approach to ensure compliance with

local and global regulations to
protect sensitive information and maintain trust.

[Schedule a call](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/contact.php?act=schedule)

![Industry we serve: DPDP Act Compliance for Healthcare icon ](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/healthcare.png)

##### DPDP Act Compliance for Healthcare

The healthcare sector processes vast amounts of sensitive
personal and health data,
requiring strict adherence to the DPDP Act, 2023. Ensuring privacy protection,
consent
management, withdrawal, right to nominate and regulatory compliance is critical.


Key Compliance Measures:

- **Data Security in Electronic Health Records (EHRs):** Implement
encryption, access controls, and secure storage for patient data.
- **Data Fiduciary & Processor Obligations:** Define clear
responsibilities for data fiduciaries and processors in the healthcare
ecosystem.
- **Consent Management:** Enable informed consent mechanisms with
withdrawal rights for data principals.
- **Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs):** Conduct regular
DPIAs to identify and mitigate data privacy risks.
- **Cross-Border Data Transfers:** Establish regulatory-compliant
frameworks for international patient data transfers.
- **Third Party Vendor Compliance:** Ensure contractual obligations
for health data processors to comply with DPDPA requirements.

![Industry we serve: DPDP Act Compliance for Insurance icon ](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/industrie/214.png)

##### DPDP Act Compliance for Insurance

Insurance firms manage highly sensitive personal and
financial data, necessitating
robust privacy frameworks.

Key Compliance Measures:

- **Privacy-by-Design in Insurance Platforms:** Integrate
privacy
controls including data minimization and clear consent policy with no
secondary
use of data, issuance, underwriting, and claims processing.

- **Automated Processing Transparency:** Ensure AI-driven
underwriting decisions are transparent and fair.
- **Breach Prevention:** Implement real-time monitoring,
encryption,
and access controls to mitigate breaches.
- **Policyholder Data Protection:** Secure processing of personal
data
with strict access control measures.
- **Cross-Border Data Compliance:** Adhere to DPDP Act and
international
regulations for secure financial data transfers.

![Industry we serve: DPDP Act Compliance for Manufacturing icon ](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/industrie/215.png)

##### DPDP Act Compliance for Manufacturing

Manufacturing companies must safeguard employee,
customer, and supply chain data
while leveraging IoT and automation.

Key Compliance Measures:

- **Secure Data Handling in HR & Supply Chains:** Encrypt and
restrict access to employee and supplier data.

- **Privacy Controls in IoT-Enabled Factories:** Implement
anonymization and access logs for smart factory data.
- **Biometric & Employee Monitoring Compliance:** Implement
lawful
identity
verification with minimal data collection.
- **Third Party Vendor Agreements:** Establish privacy-focused
contracts for supplier and vendor data processing.
- **AI & Machine Learning Risk Mitigation:** Conduct privacy
impact
assessments for predictive analytics models.

![Industry we serve: DPDP Act Compliance for Financial Services icon ](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/industrie/216.png)

##### DPDP Act Compliance for Financial Services

Banks, NBFCs, and fintech companies must ensure
stringent
data privacy controls to
protect financial transactions and customer data.

Key Compliance Measures:

- **End-to-End Encryption:** Secure financial transactions and
banking systems.

- **KYC & AML Privacy Measures:** Implement lawful identity
verification with minimal data collection.
- **Data Localization & Storage Security:** Comply with
localization
mandates while ensuring secure storage.
- **Incident Management & Breach Response:** Establish rapid
breach
notification protocols.
- **Consent-Driven Processing:** Provide transparent opt-in,
withdrawal, and control mechanisms for financial data.

![Industry we serve: DPDP Act Compliance for Retail & E-Commerce icon ](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/industrie/217.png)

##### DPDP Act Compliance for Retail & E-Commerce

Retailers and e-commerce businesses must protect
consumer
data and ensure transparent
data practices.

Key Compliance Measures:

- **Customer Data Access & Deletion Rights:** Provide easy
mechanisms for data access, correction, and deletion.

- **Secure Payment & Fraud Prevention:** Implement encryption and
fraud detection systems.
- **Personalized Marketing Compliance:** Ensure opt-in-based
targeted advertising with consent management.
- **Data Minimization Strategies:** Limit data collection for
analytics while ensuring privacy.
- **Secure Customer Rewards Data Handling:** Protect personal
information in loyalty programs.

##### DPDP Act Compliance for Technology & IT Services

Key Compliance Measures:

- **Data Fiduciary Responsibilities:** Ensure accountability for
cloud
and
service providers.

- **Vendor Risk Assessments:** Conduct privacy and security
evaluations
for
third party services.
- **DSAR Handling Mechanisms:** Implement seamless processes for data
principal access requests.
- **Privacy by Default in Digital Solutions:** Enforce data
minimization
and
lawful processing principles.
- **Regular Audits & DPIAs:** Conduct compliance assessments to

- **Parental Consent for Minors:** Ensure verifiable parental consent

- **Data Retention & Automated Deletion:** Implement strict retention

- **Secure Data Storage & Processing:** Implement encryption and

- **Cross-Border Data Transfer Compliance:** Ensure regulatory

[Principal Rights](http://tech.portal-uat.dpdpconsultants.com/dpgr_form?_gl=1)![Logo](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/call-us.png) [18005711333](tel:+18005711333)

# Tailored Advice for Seamless DPDP Act Gap Assessment Review

Our specialized compliance framework delivers comprehensive DPDP Act Gap Assessment Review through a
methodical approach that encompasses complete data mapping, gap analysis, strategic remediation, and
sustainable compliance practices.


[Schedule a call](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/contact.php?act=schedule)

![Data protection compliance consulting services “gap assessment review” icon](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/dpdp-review.png)

###### Gap assessment review

The Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA) requires organizations to be well-prepared. Our
Gap Assessment Review offers a detailed evaluation and expert guidance to help your business
meet compliance requirements with minimal disruption. Led by experienced professionals, we
provide tailored recommendations to help you navigate DPDPA compliance and stay ready for
evolving regulations.


###### Our Services

## Clear! Secure! Confident! Gap Assessment Reviews You Can Trust

[Get in touch](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/contact.php)

##### Step 1: Grounds of Processing Assessment

Section 4 of the DPDP Act stipulates that personal data processing must follow a lawful
purpose, with valid consent from the Data Principal being fundamental to compliance.
Our review ensures your processing activities align with these legal requirements,
establishing a solid foundation for ongoing compliance.

##### Step 2: Data Mapping & Inventory Analysis

We conduct a thorough assessment of all personal data within your organization:

- Identify what personal data you collect and where it resides
- Document data flows across your systems and third parties
- Classify data according to regulatory requirements
- Evaluate retention policies against DPDP Act guidelines

##### Step 3: Privacy Framework Evaluation

Our team examines your existing privacy governance structure:


- Review current privacy policies and notices for DPDPA compliance
- Assess consent management mechanisms
- Evaluate procedures for handling data principal rights
- Analyze data breach notification protocols

##### Step 4: Technical & Organizational Measures Review

We assess your security infrastructure to ensure appropriate safeguards:

- Evaluate data protection measures across systems
- Review access controls and authentication protocols
- Assess encryption standards for data at rest and in transit
- Examine data minimization and anonymization practices

##### Step 5: Gap Analysis & Remediation Planning

Based on our comprehensive assessment, we deliver:

- Detailed compliance gap analysis report
- Risk prioritization based on potential impact
- Customized remediation roadmap with clear timelines
- Resource allocation recommendations
- Executive level summary for review

# Data Protection Officer as a Service: Your Strategic Partner for DPDP Act Compliance

Our specialized DPO as a Service framework ensures comprehensive data protection and
regulatory compliance through a structured approach, including risk assessment, policy implementation,
compliance monitoring, and ongoing advisory support, safeguarding your organization’s data governance.


[Schedule a call](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/contact.php?act=schedule)

![Data protection compliance consulting services “Data Protection Officer as a Service” icon ](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/data-protection-officer.png)

###### Data Protection Officer as a Service

In today’s data-driven world, organizations face growing pressure to protect personal data. The
Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDP Act) requires appointing a Data Protection Officer
(DPO), which goes beyond compliance—it strengthens corporate governance. Our DPO as a Service
turns this requirement into a strategic advantage, enhancing your data protection framework and
building stakeholder trust.


###### Our Services

## DPO as a Service for Regulatory Compliance and Data Privacy

[Get in touch](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/contact.php)

##### Regulatory Compliance

Section 10 of the DPDPA stipulates the appointment of a Data Protection Officer for
compliance evaluation. Our DPO service fulfils this statutory requirement while
providing independent oversight free from potential internal conflicts of interest.


##### Complete Compliance Lifecycle Management

Our specialists administer all aspects of your data protection requirements, including:


- Systematic audits and continuous monitoring protocols
- Comprehensive staff training and awareness initiatives
- Strategic incident response planning and management

##### Strategic Organizational Advantage

Beyond fundamental compliance, our DPO as a Service enhances your organization by:


- Converting data protection practices into measurable customer trust
- Minimizing operational disruptions during implementation phases
- Maintaining preparedness for evolving regulatory landscapes

##### Industry-Specific Expertise

Our professional team comprises specialists across diverse sectors including healthcare,
financial services, technology, and manufacturing. We possess comprehensive
understanding of the unique data protection challenges specific to your industry and
deliver customized solutions designed to integrate seamlessly with your operational
framework. Do not merely comply with DPDP Act requirements—achieve excellence in data
protection through partnership with strategic advisors who comprehend both the
regulatory environment and your business objectives.

## Contract Review Services
[Principal Rights](http://tech.portal-uat.dpdpconsultants.com/dpgr_form?_gl=1)![Logo](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/call-us.png) [18005711333](tel:+18005711333)

# Expert Contract Review: Identifying Privacy Risks and Strengthening Your Data Processing Agreements

Our specialized contract review framework ensures comprehensive risk mitigation
through a structured approach, including detailed contract analysis, track obligations, compliance
alignment, and legal protection strategies


[Schedule a call](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/contact.php?act=schedule)

![Data protection compliance consulting services “Contract Review & Data Processing Agreements” icon ](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/service3.png)

###### Contract Review & Data Processing Agreements

Our Contract Review and Data Processing Agreement services ensure your organization complies
with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDP Act) when sharing personal data with third
parties. We help draft and review agreements that include all required provisions to protect
personal data and uphold the rights of Data Principals.


###### Our Services

## Thorough & Adaptive Contract Review Strategy for Risk-Free Agreements

[Get in touch](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/contact.php)

##### Comprehensive Contract Audits

We conduct an in-depth review of your existing vendor agreements to identify potential
compliance gaps, risks, and areas requiring amendments under the DPDP Act . Our audit
ensures that your contracts align with the latest regulatory requirements, mitigating
legal and financial risks.


##### DPDPA-Compliant Contract Development

Our legal specialists review new and existing agreements from the ground up,
incorporating all mandatory DPDP Act provisions to ensure full regulatory compliance.
These contracts are designed to safeguard data privacy, define clear responsibilities,
and minimize potential liabilities while supporting your business objectives.


##### Fiduciary-Processor Alignment

We establish well-defined data protection responsibilities and accountability mechanisms
between your organization (the fiduciary) and all third party processors. This ensures
seamless regulatory alignment, preventing ambiguities and fostering transparency in data
handling practices.


##### Negotiation Support

Our team provides expert guidance and strategic support during contract negotiations with
third party processors. We help you secure favorable terms while ensuring that all
agreements meet DPDP Act compliance standards, protecting your organization from unfair
clauses or potential risks.


##### Ongoing Compliance Monitoring

Regulations and data protection standards are constantly evolving. We offer continuous
compliance support through periodic contract reviews, updates, and audits to help you
stay ahead of new regulatory requirements and maintain airtight data privacy agreements.

###### Consulting, Advisory and Audit

Achieve seamless DPDP Act compliance with our expert support. We provide tailored policies,
privacy impact assessment, internal audit frameworks, regular compliance audits, demonstrable
evidence, and automated privacy tools to ensure your business meets regulatory requirements.
Proactively implementing IT and organizational controls protects your business from
non-compliance risks and potential penalties.


###### Our Services

## Comprehensive Consulting and Audit Framework for Data Security

[Get in touch](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/contact.php)

##### Collaborative Assessment and Strategy Development

We partner with stakeholders across your organization to thoroughly assess current
practices, identify compliance gaps, and develop a strategic roadmap tailored to your
specific business context and risk profile.


##### Pragmatic Implementation Support

Our experts provide hands-on guidance during implementation, ensuring practical solutions
that integrate seamlessly with your existing operations while meeting all regulatory
requirements.


##### Risk-Based Prioritization

We help you focus resources where they matter most by prioritizing compliance activities
based on risk exposure, business impact, and regulatory significance, creating maximum
protection with optimal resource allocation.


##### Continuous Knowledge Transfer

Throughout our engagement, we emphasize building your team's capabilities through
structured training, documentation, and mentoring, enabling self-sufficiency in
maintaining compliance long-term.

##### Adaptable Frameworks for Evolving Regulations

We design flexible compliance frameworks that can evolve alongside changing regulations
and business needs, ensuring sustained protection without requiring complete redesign as
requirements shift.

##### Measurable Outcomes and Demonstrable Compliance

Our approach emphasizes creating clear documentation and evidence trails that demonstrate
compliance efforts to regulators, business partners, and other stakeholders with
confidence.

##### Industry-Contextual Solutions

We apply our deep understanding of sector-specific challenges to create compliance
solutions that address the unique data protection requirements of your industry, from
healthcare to financial services and beyond.

##### Technology-Enabled Compliance

Where appropriate, we leverage technology solutions to automate compliance processes,
reducing manual effort while increasing consistency and creating sustainable compliance
management systems.

# DPDP Act Employee Awareness Training: Empowering Your Team for Effective Data Protection

expert guidance, interactive learning, and real-world case studies, equipping your team to navigate data
protection regulations confidently.

![Data protection compliance consulting services “Training Programs for DPDP Act, 2023 Compliance” icon ](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/training-program.png)

###### Training Programs for DPDP Act, 2023 Compliance

Our training program is customized to your organization’s needs, focusing on practical aspects
of DPDP Act, 2023 compliance. Key topics include personal data policies, data principal
rights, risk assessments, cross-border data transfer, third party compliance, security policies,
and incidental response.

privacy regulations. From practical templates to expert articles, we ensure you have everything you need
to navigate compliance with confidence.

![India’s Data Law Delay: What It Means for Businesses and Data Privacy](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/inthenews/inthenews_1_thumbnail.png)

##### [India’s Data Law Delay: What It Means for Businesses and Data Privacy](https://law.asia/delay-in-india-data-protection-law/)

**Publisher:** Law Asia

**Published:** 2025-10-28

summary

The delay in India’s Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act has left businesses uncertain and exposed to compliance risks. Without clear timelines, data accountability and privacy standards remain blurred. This article explores the causes, consequences, and how organizations can stay prepared for the eventual rollout of India’s data protection regime.

![Qantas data breach exposes up to six million customer profiles](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/inthenews/inthenews_17_thumbnail.png)

##### [Qantas data breach exposes up to six million customer profiles](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cd6gnyl9923o)

**Publisher:** BBC News

**Published:** 2025-07-03

summary

Qantas has confirmed a data breach affecting up to 6 million customers. Personal details were exposed, but financial data and passwords were not compromised. Authorities and users have been notified.

![Post Office data breach victims to get compensation](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/inthenews/inthenews_16_thumbnail.png)

##### [Post Office data breach victims to get compensation](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cje7wnd3j57o)

**Publisher:** BBC News

**Published:** 2025-05-20

summary

The Post Office will pay up to £5,000 to victims of a 2023 data breach involving 555 Horizon scandal claimants whose details were mistakenly leaked online.

![TikTok hit with €530M fine after illegally sending users’ data to China](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/inthenews/inthenews_15_thumbnail.png)

##### [TikTok hit with €530M fine after illegally sending users’ data to China](https://www.politico.eu/article/tiktok-hit-with-e530m-privacy-fine-ireland-china-data/)

**Publisher:** Upstox

**Published:** 2025-05-02

summary

TikTok has been fined €530M for breaching GDPR by transferring EU user data to China without transparency. As India gears up for the DPDP Act, the case highlights the urgent need for companies to review data transfer practices and strengthen privacy compliance.

![Localization not to restrict cross-border data flow: IT secretary](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/inthenews/inthenews_1_thumbnail.png)

##### [Localization not to restrict cross-border data flow: IT secretary](https://shorturl.at/JAGaZ)

**Publisher:** Live Mint

**Published:** 2025-03-28

summary

India is pushing for local data storage to ensure a resilient internet amid Big Tech opposition. DPDP rules may mandate localization for specific data, with oversight from a government-appointed committee, raising concerns from firms like Meta and Google over cross-border data transfers.

![Government Finalizing Data Law: Meity secretary](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/inthenews/inthenews_1_thumbnail.png)

##### [Government Finalizing Data Law: Meity secretary](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/government-finalising-data-laws-meity-secretary/articleshow/119614708.cms)

**Publisher:** Times of India

**Published:** 2025-03-28

summary

The MeitY is finalizing DPDP Act rules, tackling online content regulation, and addressing AI challenges. Cybersecurity remains a top concern as India adapts to evolving tech threats.

![NHS software provider fined £3m over data breach after ransomware attack](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/inthenews/inthenews_1_thumbnail.png)

##### [NHS software provider fined £3m over data breach after ransomware attack](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cp3yv1zxn94o)

**Publisher:** BBC News

**Published:** 2025-03-26

summary

The ICO fined NHS software provider Advanced £3M for security failings that led to a 2022 ransomware attack, exposing 79,404 records. Weak multi-factor authentication was blamed for the breach.

![India Enacts Digital Personal Data Protection Act](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/inthenews/inthenews_1_thumbnail.png)

##### [India Enacts Digital Personal Data Protection Act](https://law.asia/digital-personal-data-protection-rules-challenges-india/)

**Publisher:** Law Asia

**Published:** 2025-03-24

summary

The draft Digital Personal Data Protection Rules, 2025 aim to enhance data security and consent management in India but introduce complexities. While aligning with global standards, gaps remain in user control, cross-border data transfers, and safeguards.

![India tightens digital laws, mandates 24-hour takedown of explicit content, strengthens cybercrime response](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/inthenews/inthenews_1_thumbnail.png)

##### [India tightens digital laws, mandates 24-hour takedown of explicit content, strengthens cybercrime response](https://www.cnbctv18.com/technology/india-tightens-it-rules-digital-laws-24hr-takedown-cybercrime-19577341.htm)

**Publisher:** CNBC TV 18

**Published:** 2025-03-21

summary

The Indian government is tightening online content regulations to curb explicit material, especially child abuse content. Measures under the IT Act, 2000, and IT Rules, 2021, aim to enhance digital safety.

![DPDP Act an opportunity to drive ethical AI growth, says Adobe India MD Prativa Mohapatra](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/inthenews/inthenews_1_thumbnail.png)

##### [DPDP Act an opportunity to drive ethical AI growth, says Adobe India MD Prativa Mohapatra](https://www.moneycontrol.com/technology/dpdp-act-an-opportunity-to-drive-ethical-ai-growth-says-adobe-india-md-prativa-mohapatra-article-12969889.html)

**Publisher:** Money Control

**Published:** 2025-03-20

summary

Adobe India MD Prativa Mohapatra sees the DPDP Act as an opportunity for ethical AI. Adobe ensures compliance by using licensed data and supports IndiaAI with AI skilling and governance initiatives. Adobe India plays a key role in Firefly and AI innovation.

#### Does your organization need automation to manage your data privacy Compliance?

![Does your organization need automation to manage your data privacy Compliance?](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/events/events_14_thumbnail.png)

##### About the Event

##### Date

2025-06-05

##### Venue

Online

Full Name

Contact

Email

As privacy regulations grow more complex and enforcement ramps up, manual compliance processes are no longer enough. Join us for an insightful webinar exploring how automation can transform your organization’s approach to data privacy compliance—from consent and rights management to data governance.

In this session, you'll learn:

\- When automation becomes essential for managing privacy at scale

\- Why automated systems improve accuracy, reduce risk, and boost regulatory readiness

\- How to implement automation effectively without disrupting existing operations

\- Whether you're a privacy leader, IT manager, or compliance officer, this webinar will help you assess your current strategy and identify opportunities for smarter, scalable compliance.

Don't wait for a regulatory crisis to act—discover the power of automation today.

##### DPDPA Specialists

1 Open Role

**Team:** Product

**Location:** Noida

**Work Schedule:** Full-Time

**Work Mode:** On-site

**Experience:** 1 to 3 years (DPDPA Specialists)

We are hiring skilled DPDPA Specialists to join our organization. The Data Protection Specialist
will be responsible for ensuring compliance with DPDP Act, developing and implementing data
protection policies and procedures, and conducting risk assessments to identify potential
vulnerabilities.
To apply, mail us your resume at career@dpdpconsultants.com



##### Key Responsibilities:

- Develop and implement data protection policies and procedures

- Conduct risk assessments, Business Activity Assessments to identify potential privacy gaps.

- Work Closely with Client stakeholders to assess Privacy posture, identify gaps and provide
remediations.

- Monitor data processing activities to ensure compliance with data protection laws and
regulations.

- Provide training to employees on data protection best practices.

- Design and Implement Data principal rights management process and tools.
- Work with tech and compliance teams to ensure compliance with data protection laws such as
GDPR and DPDPA.
- Stay up-to-date on data protection laws and regulations and make recommendations for updates
to policies and procedures.


##### Required Skills & Qualifications

- Experience in information technology , data protection or information security or relevant
domain.

- Good understanding of data protection laws and regulations

- Good understanding of business process and Privacy Controls

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team
- Detail-oriented and able to handle confidential information with discretion

##### Open to Travel

- These positions are based in HQ (Sector-142, Noida) and is Work from office only

- If you are a dedicated and knowledgeable Data Protection Specialist looking to join a
dynamic team, we encourage you to apply for this position.

[Apply Now](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/contact.php?act=careers&job=DPDPA%20Specialists)

##### PostgreSQL Database Administrator (On-Premise, Multi–Data Center Replication)

1 Open Role

**Team:** Product

**Location:** Noida

**Work Schedule:** Full-Time / Contract

**Work Mode:** On-site

**Experience:** 3 to 5+ years (PostgreSQL Administration & Replication)

**Job Description:** We are seeking an experienced PostgreSQL Database Administrator
(DBA) to manage and maintain our on-premise PostgreSQL infrastructure deployed across multiple
data centers. The DBA will be responsible for implementing, monitoring, and optimizing logical
replication between data centers, ensuring high availability, data integrity, and automatic
recovery in case of network or hardware failures.


The role involves working on a one-master-at-a-time replication model, ensuring seamless master
rotation every six months, and maintaining synchronization between the data centers even during
internet or network interruptions.

##### Key Responsibilities:

- Design, configure, and maintain PostgreSQL databases for high availability and performance
across multiple on-premise data centers.

- Implement and manage logical replication with one master node active at a time.

- Ensure replication auto-start and auto-sync in case of network or connectivity disruptions.

- Plan and execute scheduled master rotations (every six months) between data centers with
minimal downtime.

- Continuously monitor database health, replication status, and performance metrics.

- Develop and maintain scripts for automated failover, recovery, and sync resumption after
outages.
- Perform backup and restore operations ensuring data consistency across environments.
- Optimize database performance through indexing, query tuning, and partitioning strategies.

- Collaborate with DevOps, Networking, and Application teams to ensure database reliability
and security.

##### Required Skills & Qualifications

- Strong hands-on experience (5+ years) administering PostgreSQL (v12 or higher) in production
environments.

- Proven expertise in setting up and managing logical replication, streaming replication, and
high-availability clusters.

- Experience with multi–data center replication and failover/fallback mechanisms.

- Proficient in designing auto-start and auto-sync replication scripts (using Bash, Python, or
Ansible).
- Understanding of network routing, firewall, and latency optimization for database
replication across sites.
- Experience with PgBouncer, Patroni, or repmgr for HA management.
- Solid understanding of backup and disaster recovery strategies.
- Familiarity with monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, pgAdmin, Zabbix, or similar).
- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with a focus on reliability and fault
tolerance.

##### Preferred Qualifications

- Certification in PostgreSQL Administration or Linux Systems.

- Experience with Docker-based PostgreSQL deployments.
- Prior work with Python Flask or web applications connecting to PostgreSQL backends.
- Knowledge of PostgreSQL replication conflict resolution and logical decoding.

##### Key Environment Details

- Deployment Model: On-Premise
- Data Centers: DC1, DC2 (active replication)
- Replication Type: Logical (one master active)
- Failover Behavior: Auto start on network recovery, auto sync after downtime
- Master Rotation: Scheduled every 6 months

[Apply Now](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/contact.php?act=careers&job=PostgreSQL%20Database%20Administrator)

1 Open Role

**Team:** Product

**Job Description:** DPDP Consultants is a leading technology and compliance

policies and external regulations.

and external auditors.

Industry.

- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

- Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.

- Demonstrated leadership and people management skills.

###### Real Success. Real Impact.

### 12,000+ professionals of companies like Tata Motors, Mindforce Research, SK Finance and many more are already certified

1

![Internship Program](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/education-pro/internship-program.png)

#### Internship Opportunity

- **Hands-on Projects:** Work on real-world DPDP Law compliance assignments.

- **Mentorship:** Guided by experienced legal and data protection
consultants.
- **Policy Drafting:** Learn to create data protection policies, consent
forms, and
data processing agreements.
- **Tool Training:** Get exposure to data protection automation tools and
frameworks.

- **Career Support:** Resume reviews, LinkedIn optimization, and mock
interviews.

- **Certificate of Completion:** Recognized by industry experts.

2

![Online Learning Module](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/education-pro/online-learning.svg)

#### Get Certification

- **Comprehensive Course:** Step-by-step breakdown of the DPDPA 2023
and its applicability.
- **Self-Paced Learning:** Access anytime, anywhere—learn at your own
convenience.

- **Assessment:** Test your knowledge after the module.
- **Completion Certificate:** A credible testament to your learning journey
and newly acquired data protection skills — recognized by industry professionals


3

![Course Material](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/education-pro/course-material.png)

#### DPDPA Guidebook

- **In-Depth Guide:** A comprehensive, easy-to-understand breakdown of the
DPDP Act 2023.
- **Section-by-section Analysis:** Simplified explanations of key provisions
and compliance requirements
- **Practical Insights:** Real-world interpretations and industry-relevant
applications.
- **Updated Content:** Aligned with the latest amendments and government
notifications.

4

![Webinars](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/education-pro/exclusive-webinar.png)

#### Exclusive Webinar Invitations (top scorers)

- **Live Sessions with Experts:** Interact directly with leading data
protection professionals, legal advisors and thought leaders
- **Deep Dives into Hot Topics:** Explore key issues like cross-border data
flow, consent management, and compliance tech.
- **Real-Time Q&A:** Get your questions answered live by practitioners
working in the field.
- **Career Guidance:** Insights on roles, skills, and opportunities in the
data protection landscape.
- **Webinar Recordings:** Lifetime access to all sessions for future
reference.

Designed for Curious Minds and Ambitious Professionals

Your Trusted Guide to Mastering Data

Protection with Precision and Insight


##### Law Professionals

- In-depth modules on the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act
- Hands-on sessions on privacy policy frameworks
- Case studies on landmark judgments, compliance penalties, and enforcement actions
- Diversifying portfolio with privacy specialization

##### Business Management Professionals

- Tools for assessing ROI from compliance programs
- Equipping business leaders with the knowledge to embed privacy as a business enabler

- Strengthening strategic decision-making around customer trust and data ethics
- Insights on risk management, data governance, and vendor compliance

##### Tech Students

- Making privacy-aware developers and architects since inception
- Aligns with industry demands for privacy-literate tech talent
- Edge in product design, software engineering roles
- Gain hands-on experience to work on privacy tools
- Learn tools that help automate compliance tasks

##### Early Professionals

- Foundational understanding of privacy principles
- Exposure to real-world scenarios
- Pivoting into the roles of such as privacy analysts, compliance associates, or policy
officers
- Career Opportunities in the growing privacy landscape

##### Compliance Experts

- Deep dives into compliance frameworks, audit readiness, and operationalizing DPDPA
- Insight into tools for conducting Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIA), risk
assessments, and internal audits
- Design and implement robust privacy compliance programs
- Keeps them updated with changing regulatory expectations and best practices

## Frequently Asked Questions

## Who are DPDP Consultants?

DPDP Consultants is a leading techno-legal consulting advisory firm specializing in Digital
Personal Data Protection compliance. We offer expert advisory, strategic data Protection
consulting, Impact assessments and Privacy Management tools to help organizations align with
India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA), 2023. Our trusted clientele includes
prominent names such as Tata Motors, Bajaj Finserv, Ashok Leyland, Carl Zeiss and APRAAVA
Energy among many others.



## What is the DPDP Act Foundation Course?

This is a self-paced, online certification course crafted by DPDP Consultants to build
foundational expertise in digital data protection under the DPDPA. It blends theory with
practical insights and includes the opportunity to earn a merit-based internship.


## Who should take this course?

Ideal for students and early-career professionals as well as business experts from these
domains:


- Law
- Technology & Engineering
- Business Administration
- Sales & Marketing
- Data Governance and Privacy

## What does the course include?

- Comprehensive Breakdown of DPDP Act
- Internship Opportunity for top 100 Professionals across various fields
- Structured learning modules with reading materials
- Case studies and real-world scenarios
- Assessments
- Certification on completion

**Note:** Up to three attempts are allowed to clear the final
assessment.

## What will I learn?

You will:


- Grasp the essentials of the DPDPA framework
- Master core concepts in data privacy and protection
- Understand how to apply compliance practices
- Be prepared to lead or support DPDPA implementation initiatives

## How do I register?

- Visit the official registration page
- Complete the form and pay the course fee
- Get access to course materials and updates via email

## What’s the course fee?

A one-time fee of ₹1,599 (plus GST as applicable) grants full access to the program. There
will be no refund once you subscribe to the course.



## How many internships will be given?

A total of 100 internships across various fields, including Law, Marketing, Sales,
Technology, etc. will be provided.



## How does the internship selection process work?

Top 100 performing learners will be shortlisted for internships with DPDP Consultants. The
Selection is merit-based and subject to availability.


## Will I get a certificate?

Yes. All who complete the course and pass assessments receive a Certificate of Completion.
Selected interns also receive a formal Internship Offer Letter.



## What tasks are assigned during the internship?

Internships are tailored to your background:


- **Law:** Legal research, documentation, compliance analysis
- **MBA/Marketing:** Branding, campaign design, digital outreach
- **Marketing Sales:** CRM support, business development, lead generation

- **Tech:** Data security tools, privacy tech, technical audits

## Is the internship paid?

Yes. Interns receive a competitive stipend. Travel and accommodation are not covered.



## Can working professionals or students apply for internships?

Absolutely. The internship is flexible, allowing you to balance it with other commitments.
On-site sessions may be encouraged for deeper exposure.


## Is there a time limit for the course?

Yes. While it’s self-paced, access to the platform and final assessment timelines will be
shared at the time of registration.



## What if I need help?

Reach out for technical or academic support at:
![](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/assets/images/email-icon.png)[course-support@dpdpconsultants.com](mailto:course-support@dpdpconsultants.com)

## What career benefits can I expect?

This course gives you a competitive advantage in roles involving:


- Data Protection & Privacy
- Corporate Compliance
- Governance & Risk
- Privacy Tech Integration

# Frequently Asked Questions about the DPDP Act 2023

## What services does DPDP Consultants offer for data privacy and compliance?

DPDP Consultants specializes in providing comprehensive services tailored to data privacy and
compliance needs. Our offerings include DPDP Act Readiness Review, Data Privacy Policy Drafting,
Privacy Impact Assessments, Contract Review for Data Protection Compliance, DPDP Act Compliance
Assistance, and Employee Training on Data Protection Regulations. We aim to simplify the
compliance journey for businesses by offering end-to-end data protection solutions.



## How can DPDP Consultants assist businesses in achieving DPDP Act compliance?

DPDP Consultants offers expert assistance in aligning your business processes with the
requirements of the Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDP Act) 2023. Our team conducts a
thorough gap analysis, provides compliance roadmaps, and supports the implementation of privacy
frameworks. With our guidance, organizations can confidently navigate complex regulatory
requirements, reduce risks, and ensure seamless compliance with the DPDP Act 2023.



## What is the DPDP Act 2023, and why is it essential for businesses?

The Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 is a transformative law in India focused on
protecting individuals' personal data. It mandates that businesses comply with data privacy
regulations, implement robust data management practices, and ensure the security of customer
information. Failure to comply can result in significant penalties and reputational damage.
Businesses must prioritize data privacy and adopt compliance measures to stay competitive and
trustworthy.



## Why is data protection crucial for modern businesses?

In today's digital age, data protection is a cornerstone of building customer trust and ensuring
business sustainability. It helps organizations safeguard sensitive information, comply with
laws like the DPDP Act 2023, and mitigate the risk of data breaches. Effective data protection
enhances brand reputation, fosters customer loyalty, and ensures smooth operations in a
data-driven economy.



## How can I contact DPDP Consultants for expert guidance on data privacy?

You can connect with DPDP Consultants through multiple channels. Visit our office in Noida,
Uttar Pradesh, call us at 0120-6930999, or email us at info@dpdpconsultants.com. Our team of
experts is ready to assist you with your data privacy and compliance needs.



## What is included in a DPDP Act Readiness Review by DPDP Consultants?

Our DPDP Act Readiness Review evaluates your organization’s current data protection framework.
We identify gaps in compliance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023, recommend
actionable improvements, and help implement changes to meet regulatory standards. This service
is ideal for businesses seeking a proactive approach to privacy compliance.



## Does DPDP Consultants offer customized training programs on data privacy?

Yes, DPDP Consultants provides bespoke training programs designed to educate your employees
about data privacy laws, including the DPDP Act 2023, GDPR, and other international regulations.
Our training equips teams with practical knowledge to handle personal data responsibly and
mitigate privacy risks effectively.



## How does DPDP Consultants tailor its data compliance solutions for different industries?

At DPDP Consultants, we recognize that each industry faces unique data protection challenges.
Our team conducts in-depth assessments to design customized compliance solutions that align with
industry-specific regulations and business objectives. From healthcare and finance to e-commerce
and IT, we deliver targeted strategies to ensure compliance with the DPDP Act 2023 and beyond.



## Why choose DPDP Consultants as your data protection partner?

DPDP Consultants is a trusted name in the field of data privacy and compliance, backed by a team
of experts with extensive knowledge of global regulations like the DPDP Act 2023 and GDPR. We
offer personalized, cost-effective solutions that simplify compliance and enhance data security.
Our proven track record and commitment to excellence make us the ideal partner for businesses
looking to achieve robust data protection.



## How does DPDP Consultants ensure data security in compliance projects?

DPDP Consultants employs a combination of advanced data security measures, robust risk
assessment methodologies, and tailored compliance strategies to ensure your organization’s data
remains secure. We integrate encryption practices, access control mechanisms, and regular audits
to protect sensitive information in line with the DPDP Act 2023 and other privacy standards.



## What industries can benefit from DPDP Consultants’ expertise?

DPDP Consultants caters to a wide range of industries, including healthcare, finance, education,
e-commerce, IT services, and manufacturing. Each industry faces unique data privacy challenges,
and we provide specialized solutions to meet their compliance needs under the DPDP Act 2023,
GDPR, and other regulations.



## What are the penalties for non-compliance with the DPDP Act 2023?

Non-compliance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 can lead to significant
penalties, including monetary fines, legal actions, and reputational damage. Businesses must
proactively adopt compliance measures such as privacy audits, staff training, and robust data
security practices to avoid these consequences. DPDP Consultants helps organizations mitigate
these risks effectively.


## What is the role of a Privacy Impact Assessment (PIA)?

A Privacy Impact Assessment (PIA) is a critical tool to evaluate how data processing activities
affect individual privacy. DPDP Consultants conducts PIAs to help organizations identify risks,
ensure compliance with the DPDP Act 2023, and implement safeguards for sensitive data. PIAs are
essential for building trust and enhancing organizational transparency.



## How does DPDP Consultants stay updated with global data privacy regulations?

Our team of experts continually monitors changes in global data privacy laws, including the
GDPR, CCPA, and the DPDP Act 2023. We participate in industry forums, attend compliance
workshops, and maintain relationships with legal professionals to ensure our clients receive the
latest and most accurate guidance.

# Privacyium Privacy Notice

## PRIVACY NOTICE

DPDP Consultants (“DPDP Consultants,” “we,” “us,” or “our”) respects and understands
the importance of your privacy – and is therefore committed to affording complete protection of
your personal information. It is in recognition of this need for security, our commitment to the
DPDP Act 2023, and secured management of any information received/collected by us that DPDP
Consultants has established this Privacy Notice.

This Privacy Notice (“Privacy Notice”) explains how we collect, use, protect, and
disclose your personal information when you use the DPDP Consultants websites (the “Websites”)
and/or DPDP Consultants products, solutions and services (collectively with the Websites, the
“Services”). This Privacy Notice also explains how you can manage your information preferences.


This Privacy Notice applies to our websites – [(www.dpdpconsultants.com)](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/www.dpdpconsultants.com), products & solutions and our
marketing practices. We ensure total transparency in all our interactions with data principals.
Data Privacy is important to us, and we strive to be transparent in our data collection and use
practices.

Please note that this website is not designed for children under the age of 18, and
we do not intentionally gather information about minors.

### Effective Date: 27-02-2025

##### How does DPDP Consultants ensure the protection of your personal information?

DPDP Consultants is dedicated to ensuring the security of your personal data
through:

- Compliance with applicable legal requirements and internal privacy policies.
- Implementation of technical and organizational measures to prevent unauthorized processing,
accidental loss, alteration, disclosure, access, or destruction of data.

##### Which categories of personal data do we collect and how do we process such personal data? How do we use the information collected?

- At DPDP Consultants, we collect and process personal data from various stakeholders,
including employees, job applicants, clients, suppliers, business contacts, shareholders,
and website users. The legal basis for processing may vary, including legitimate interests
or user consent, always ensuring compliance with privacy regulations.

The following table outlines the categories of personal data we collect, the types
of information captured under each category, the purposes for processing, and the corresponding
legal basis.


| Sr. No. | Category of Personal Data | Types of personal information collected by category | Purpose | Lawful Grounds |
| 1 | Personal Information from Website Visitors | Name, email, phone number (via "Contact Us" forms or job applications) | To respond to inquiries, process job applications, or provide requested<br> information | Consent (Section 6 of DPDPA) |
| 2 | Support and Maintenance Information | Name, email, phone number, payment details, eligibility information | To provide support and maintain products or services | Consent (Section 6 of DPDPA) |
| 3 | Usage Information (Online Products & Applications) | IP address, device type, browser details, search terms | For website functionality, analytics, and service improvements | Consent<br> (Section 6 of DPDPA) |
| 4 | Marketing Campaign Emails | Email activity data (email opened, links clicked) | To improve marketing strategies and engagement | Consent (Section 6 of DPDPA) |
| 5 | Social Media Interactions | Information about interactions with buttons or tools, browser data | To understand user engagement and improve user experience | Consent (Section 6 of DPDPA) |
| 6 | Job Applications | Resume data, contact details | To process job applications | Consent<br> (Section 6 of DPDPA) |
| 7 | Hosted Services (Third party Service Providers) | Data processed by technology services (e.g., web hosting, analytics) | To provide technology services and maintain product offerings | Consent (Section 6 of DPDPA) |
| 8 | Customisation and contact information for Newsletter | Name, Email Address | To provide personalization of newsletters, newsletters updates and Managing<br> subscriptions | Consent (Section 6 of DPDPA) |
| 9 | Legal Obligations | PI required by court orders or legal processes | Legal compliance | Legitimate use (Section 7 of DPDPA) |
| 10 | Mergers and Acquisitions | Customer PI (if transferred) | Continuity of service during company mergers or acquisitions | Legitimate use (Section 7 of DPDPA) |

### Data Retention Policy

DPDP Consultants retains personal data only for as long as necessary. Our records
management and retention policies ensure timely deletion of data based on the following
criteria:

- Data is retained for the duration of specified processing Activity our ongoing relationship
with you.
- We store your information as long as required to deliver services.
- Data may be retained to fulfil legal and regulatory obligations where applicable.

#### Where do we store this data?

Information and data files are stored on our servers and the servers of companies we hire to
provide services to us. We use AWS Cloud, infrastructure to store such data, and the data is
stored with strict security measures. We do not share, sell, or lease any kind of information
collected to any third parties.

#### How do we secure the information collected?

We understand that the security of your information is vital and have in place strong
administrative, technical, and physical security controls and measures to keep data safe and
secure. Our privacy practices are designed to provide protection for your personal information,
all over the world. To protect information stored in our servers, through Amazon Web Service
infrastructure at India, access is limited (through user/password credentials and two-factor
authentication) to those employees who require it to perform their job functions. We use
industry-standard Secure Socket Layer (SSL) encryption technology to safeguard the account
registration process and sign-up information. Other security safeguards include but are not
limited to multifactor authentication, data encryption, firewalls, and physical access controls
to buildings and files We would like to caution our visitors about phishing attacks, wherein
unscrupulous third parties seek to extract sensitive and confidential information from you by
posing as a genuine website or by sending an email misrepresenting it to be from a genuine
source. Please be aware that we never seek sensitive or confidential information such as
regarding your financial or health record through emails or through our websites. If you receive
such a message claiming to be from DPPD Consultants, then please do not reply to it and
immediately bring it to our attention by contacting us at [dpo@dpdpconsultants.com](mailto:dpo@dpdpconsultants.com). DPDP
Consultants also recognizes the receipt, transmission, or distribution of spam emails
(unsolicited bulk emails) as a major concern and has taken reasonable measures, to minimize the
transmission and effect of spam emails in its computing environment.

#### Can this information be reviewed?

In some cases, and at our discretion this information may be accessed by respective organizations
to correct any mistake in that information, and to delete any information we no longer have
business reasons for retaining. You can do this by sending us an email. DPDP Consultants strives
to comply with all applicable laws around the globe that are designed to protect your privacy
and information, no matter where that information is collected, transferred, or retained.
Although legal requirements may vary from country to country, we intend to adhere to the
principles set forth in this Privacy Notice even if information is transferred from your country
to other countries that may not require an adequate level of protection for your information.


#### International Data Transfers

DPDP Consultants does not transfer personal data outside India. We ensure that all data collected
and processed remains within the country's jurisdiction, in compliance with the provisions of
the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, while maintaining stringent security measures to
protect your information.

#### Rights over your personal data

Under certain circumstances, by law, you have the right to:

#### Right to Rectification

You may request the correction of inaccurate or incomplete personal data held by us, ensuring it
remains accurate and current. Please inform us if your personal data changes during your
association with us.

#### Right to Erasure

You can request the deletion of personal data where you believe there are no lawful grounds for
its continued processing.

#### Right to Access

Requests for access to or copies of your personal data must be submitted in writing. We will
endeavour to respond within a reasonable timeframe, typically within one month, in compliance
with Data Protection Legislation. This information will be provided free of charge unless the
request is manifestly unfounded or excessive.

#### Right to Nomination

You may nominate an individual who, in the event of your death or incapacity, can exercise your
data rights on your behalf.

#### Right to Grievance Redressal

You have the right to access grievance redressal mechanisms provided by data fiduciaries or
consent managers, ensuring prompt responses within specified timeframes. If your grievance
remains unresolved after exhausting these mechanisms, you have the right to file a complaint
with the Data Protection Board.

#### Contact Us

To ensure your privacy and security, we may take reasonable measures to confirm your identity
before processing any request. To exercise your Data Protection rights, please visit our [Principal rights page](https://tech.portal-uat.dpdpconsultants.com/dpgr_form?_gl=1)

If you have additional queries – reach out to  dpo@dpdpconsultants.com

If you feel that your data privacy rights have been compromised despite our efforts, we encourage
you to approach DPDP Consultants first to resolve the issue. You may also choose to file a
complaint with the relevant Data Protection Board or pursue legal action in a competent court
within your country of residence, workplace, or where the alleged violation took place.

To request data erasure, rectification, or access as a job applicant, please contact us directly.
For any other rights, feel free to reach out using the contact information provided.

#### Minors and Service Usage

- As stated earlier, we do not intentionally gather or request personal information from
individuals below the age of 18.
- If you are under 18, please refrain from registering for our services or sharing any
personal information with us.
- In the event we become aware that we have obtained personal data from someone under 18, we
will take immediate steps to delete that information.
- If you suspect that a child under the age of 18 has shared personal information with us,
please contact us at [dpo@dpdpconsultants.com](mailto:dpo@dpdpconsultants.com).


#### Updates to Privacy Notice

We’re constantly trying to improve our Websites and Services, so we may need to change this
Privacy Notice from time to time as well. We will inform you regarding material changes, for
example, placing a notice on our websites when we are required to do so by applicable law. You
can see when this Privacy Notice was last updated by checking the date at the top of this page.
You are responsible for periodically reviewing this Privacy Notice.

#### Right to Complain to the Data Protection Board of India

You may contact the Data Protection Board of India if you have any concerns about how DPDP
Consultants has handled your personal data and you also have the right to make a complaint at
any time to the Data Protection board of India, the Indian enforcement authority for data
protection issues if DPDP Consultants has not been able to provide reasonable and timely
resolution to your request or grievances.

#### Notification of Changes

If we decide to change our Privacy Notice, we will post those changes on this page, so our users
are always aware of the information we collect and how we use it. If at any point we decide to
use personally identifiable information in a manner different from that stated at the time it
was collected, we will notify users by way of an email. Users will have a choice as to whether
we use their information in this different manner. We will use information in accordance with
the Privacy Notice under which the information was collected. Where links are provided to other
websites it should be noted that they are not and cannot be governed by our Privacy Notice. We
cannot guarantee your privacy when you access other websites through any link provided on this
website.

# Terms & Conditions for DPDP Act Foundation Course

By accessing or using any of the online platforms operated by DPDP Consultants including but not
limited to our website, mobile applications, social media channels, or any other digital
services provided by DPDP Consultants (collectively referred to as the “Platforms”), you
acknowledge and agree to be bound by these Terms of Use. We encourage you to read these Terms of
Use carefully, along with our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree with these Terms of Use or the
Privacy Policy, please refrain from using our Platforms.

Subject to these Terms of Use, DPDP Consultants grants you a limited, non-exclusive,
non-transferable right to access and make personal, non-commercial use of its Platforms. These
Terms of Use constitute an electronic contract between DPDP Consultants, a company incorporated
in India with its registered office at Privacyium Tech, GM IT Park, 4th Floor, Plot No. 32–33,
Sector 142, Noida – 201305, Uttar Pradesh, and you, the user of the Platforms (hereinafter
referred to as “you” or “your”).

DPDP Consultants reserves the right to modify or update these Terms of Use at its sole discretion
by posting the revised version on the Platforms. Your continued use of the Platforms following
any such changes signifies your acceptance of the updated Terms. It is your responsibility to
review the Terms of Use periodically to stay informed of any updates.

DPDP Consultants reserves the right to modify or update these Terms of Use at its sole discretion
by posting the revised version on the Platforms. Your continued use of the Platforms following
any such changes signifies your acceptance of the updated Terms. It is your responsibility to
review the Terms of Use periodically to stay informed of any updates.

1\. Fees and Subscription Terms

- DPDP Consultants reserves the right to introduce or revise fees for access to any part of
its Platforms or services at its sole discretion. Currently, access to the DPDP Act
Foundation Course is available upon payment of a one-time Enrollment Fee of ₹1599 (Indian
Rupees One Thousand Five Hundred Ninety-Nine only) exclusive of all taxes. This fee is
non-refundable, regardless of course progress, completion, or user withdrawal.
- By enrolling on the course, you agree to pay the Enrollment Fee as specified at the time of
registration. No additional charges are applicable during the subscription period, unless
there is a change in applicable taxes as per prevailing laws.
- Payment of the Enrollment Fee can be made through the payment methods listed on our
Platforms. Please note that payment alone does not confirm your enrollment. DPDP Consultants
reserves the right to decline or cancel any enrollment request at its discretion, without
assigning any reason. In such cases, the Enrollment Fee will be refunded in full, without
any interest.
- DPDP Consultants also reserves the right to revise the fee structure or payment terms at any
time. Any such changes will be communicated clearly on the Platforms.

2\. Account Registration and Security

- To access the DPDP Act Foundation Course, you may be required to create an account as part
of the registration process. During this process, you will be asked to provide certain
information and create login credentials by setting a password and supplying a valid email
address, or by linking to
- an existing third-party account (such as Google or Facebook).
- By registering, you warrant that all information provided by you is true, accurate, current,
and complete. You also agree to promptly update any changes to this information to ensure
its continued accuracy.
- Unless explicitly permitted by DPDP Consultants, each registration is intended for
individual use only. Sharing your login credentials or account access with others is
strictly prohibited. Doing so may result in the immediate suspension or termination of your

## Data Protection Compliance Insights
![](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/research/images/0a8621feed74de57837cbd35d594b390dd9442413f91bf79276989e9bb3ac452.jpg)

# RESEARCH REPORT

Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 - Study

# TABLE OF CONTENTS

Introduction

I. Methodology

II. Key findings

1. Awareness

2. Concerns and Expectations

3. Solutions and Steps to be DPDPA Compliant


III. Conclusion

# INTRODUCTION

In the last ten years, India has surprised the world by proliferating in various aspects; the most significant one has been digitalisation, and the acceptance of digital transformation has been rapid in India; adaptation has been seamless considering the 140-crore population. India is now a digitally powered economy.

With innovation and technology invariably comes significant responsibilities. For a country like India, arguably the most challenging responsibility is ensuring data privacy and security of the digital data of each individual.

At the onset, what looked like the tip of the iceberg is now clearly visible and is more prominent than expected, in the light of which the discretionary need for personal data protection has metamorphosed into a fundamental right, materializing eventually as a constitutionally protected data protection law (the DPDP Act of 2023). Did we run too fast and too far, or was It the need of the hour? Only time will tell.

The good news is that there are no oppositions, no more debates, no more "ifs" and "buts”, and most importantly, no more delays. It is out and here to stay. The Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 begins a long journey.

Today, while India contends with the world's top economies, it has also commendably joined the race for privacy protection laws with the likes of GDPR - Europe, the Data Protection Act 2018 – United Kingdom, and the California Consumer Privacy Act – United States. This is just the first milestone achieved.

Through a comprehensive study involving a sample size of 500 interviews, this report focuses on awareness of the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023, its implementation and the possible consequences of noncompliance.

Furthermore, it touches upon the need and urgency to implement data protection tools and support necessary to cater to the vast and multifaceted Indian economy.

While India is known for its ability to adapt to new laws and occasional abrupt statutory

announcements quickly, it will be interesting to see how the country faces the challenges of enforcing DPDP compliance in the coming

years.

# JOURNEY SO FAR

# 2017

This emerged from the assurance of life and personal liberty outlined to Article 21 of the constitution

# 2019

The bill is passed to the Joint Parliamentary Committee (JPC) for examination

![](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/research/images/08a9e9b4b04951204e8ae69eb3fba4148034f55a4b6f634280793bb58028a846.jpg)

# 2021

JPC takes tine to analyse the draft due to the harsh criticism from several fronts

# 2022

In Aug, 2022, PDPB 2019 was withdrawn, and a new version – Digital Personal Data Protection Bill was presented for public consultation in Nov. 2022

# 2023

On August 11, 2023, India finally celebrates the enactment of a comprehensive Data Privacy Law.

# METHODOLOGY

# Sample :

We collaborated with a premier primary research firm, Mindforce Research to survey a diverse sample of 500 participants across India, including 67% from metropolises such as Delhi, Mumbai, Bangalore, Chennai and Kolkata, along with $33 %$ of tier-2 cities like Bhuvaneswar, Chandigarh and Indore.

With an employee size ranging from 50 to $1 0 0 0 +$ , the participants were picked from various organisational functions, including Finance/Accounting, Human Resources, Legal/ Compliance, IT/Security,

![](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/research/images/e6ad9be1ca09a64815816116c904cdd1c1216f3676eefb2bc2fe02b5118f7ea5.jpg)

ORGANIZATION SIZE

Marketing/Advertising, Sales, and Operations. The focus industries cover Automotive, Financial Services, Healthcare, Manufacturing, NGO, Real Estate, Retail, Travel and Tourism, and Technology, encompassing C-level executives, Vice Presidents, Directors, Managers, and Outside Consultants.

![](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/research/images/9c70f03aaaed8f57e6e0bcca0c30d6735674fbbc3b8a6f1036254dfd6834da3f.jpg)

# KEY FINDINGS

# Awareness :

It is encouraging to see that within a span of just five months, $7 4 . 2 %$ of participants, from small businesses to large enterprises, mentioned that they had heard about the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 through sources such as colleagues, friends and thanks to "Digital India", even from the latest available articles and blogs on the internet.

![](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/research/images/ba8f66d12d835435585e46e566c34b29b35d785e43b3fb73bcc4425060861155.jpg)

# ORGANIZATIONAL AWARENESS OF DPDP ACT 2023

Interestingly, around $32 %$ of medium-sized business respondents were unaware of the DPDP Act 2023.

$40 %$ of managers to director level personnel have no hint that such a law has been passed

A concerning and unexpected observation was made — 33% of respondents had no clue of the potential violations of the DPDP Act, which can lead to fines of up to INR 250 Crore. A general notion is that companies would contact lawyers and legal firms to seek implementation and support in compliance matters. Law firms will only be able to support the specifics of the law, but implementation is not something that law firms can take on. Looking at the breaches and penalties, this law seems less lenient if one relies only on research reports and half-baked online information.

We have seen the classic example of GST. Initially, with GST, various businesses failed to map their accounting software and IT systems, which were concerned with the new tax provisions, to create invoices for GST and various required abstract reports. Moreover, their staff did not possess the necessary skills and knowledge, as training materials were not readily available. Many businesses relied on the available knowledge on the internet for implementation through self-learning and avoided expert advice and consultation. Unfortunately for many, it turned out to be a penny-wise, pound-foolish move. Some faced penalties under the following heads:

Incorrect Returns: Submitting incorrect or inaccurate information in GST returns such as understating tax liability, providing false information, and not rectifying errors promptly.

Non-Compliance: Failure to comply with GST regulations, such as not registering for GST when required, not maintaining proper records, and not issuing correct tax invoices.

Overall, about $74 %$ of participants feel the law will be enforced anytime between 6 months to 2 years.

This contrasts with only $5 3 . 3 %$ of compliance professionals who might be involved with routine aspects of the companies’ legalities.

# STRATEGIES AND AUTOMATION TRENDS IN PERSONAL DATA PROTECTION

Primarily, all companies, in some way or another, handle or process people’s personal data such as name, E-mail, phone number, Aadhar, PAN, Biometrics, and even financial information like bank account details and credit card numbers. Section 6 of the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 seeks consent from all individuals whose data is stored and/or processed into a company’s ecosystem, when asked how companies plan to be compliant.

• $50 %$ of companies are looking at automation tools to manage consent from all individuals whose data is stored and/or processed into their ecosystem.

However, only $40 %$ of the retail and tourism industry participants showed interest in using automation/tools, which essentially use much more personal data for multiple purposes ranging from transaction details to updating customers on the latest offers, deals and launches.

Around $80 %$ of IT/Technology companies are open to automation/tools to manage the consent of individuals/customers.

# DATA RETENTION AND AUTOMATION AWARENESS IN TRAVEL & TOURISM

The Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 is extremely clear about data retention. An organisation cannot collect/store/share any personal data they do not require. $67 %$ of travel and tourism professionals feel they can manually archive organisational data, and about $5 5 %$ of outside consultants who participated suggest they archive data manually for their clients

![](https://www.dpdpconsultants.com/research/images/3b75fbc5f049d666a50093eb344453c8c625197e5699b3f5405d1ed3f2316e14.jpg)

PLAN TO ARCHIVE ORGANIZATIONAL DATA
